def resolve_export_target(key: str) -> tuple[Path, str, str]:
    """Infer output path, scope, and manuscript asset label from one artifact key."""

    if key in MANUSCRIPT_ASSET_FILENAMES:
        filename = MANUSCRIPT_ASSET_FILENAMES[key]
        return MANUSCRIPT_RESULTS_DIR / filename, "manuscript", filename
    if key in SECONDARY_OUTPUT_FILENAMES:
        filename = SECONDARY_OUTPUT_FILENAMES[key]
        return SECONDARY_OUTPUT_DIR / filename, "secondary", ""
    raise KeyError(f"Unregistered export key: {key}")


def theme_rr_minimal() -> None:
    """Apply one deterministic, journal-safe figure style across the notebook."""

    plt.rcParams.update(
        {
            "font.family": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["font_family"],
            "font.size": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["base_size"],
            "axes.titlesize": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["title_size"],
            "axes.labelsize": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["label_size"],
            "xtick.labelsize": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["tick_size"],
            "ytick.labelsize": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["tick_size"],
            "legend.fontsize": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["legend_size"],
            "axes.titleweight": "normal",
            "axes.edgecolor": ANALYSIS_COLORS["axis"],
            "axes.labelcolor": ANALYSIS_COLORS["ink"],
            "text.color": ANALYSIS_COLORS["ink"],
            "xtick.color": ANALYSIS_COLORS["axis"],
            "ytick.color": ANALYSIS_COLORS["axis"],
            "figure.facecolor": "white",
            "axes.facecolor": "white",
            "savefig.dpi": 300,
            "savefig.facecolor": "white",
        }
    )


def set_analysis_plot_style() -> None:
    """Backward-compatible wrapper for the shared figure theme."""

    theme_rr_minimal()


def finish_rr_axis(ax: plt.Axes, *, x_grid: bool = False, y_grid: bool = True) -> None:
    """Apply a readable publication-style axis treatment."""

    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color(ANALYSIS_COLORS["axis"])
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color(ANALYSIS_COLORS["axis"])
    ax.grid(axis="x", color=ANALYSIS_COLORS["grid"], linestyle="-", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8 if x_grid else 0.0)
    ax.grid(axis="y", color=ANALYSIS_COLORS["grid"], linestyle="-", linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.8 if y_grid else 0.0)
    ax.set_axisbelow(True)


def finish_axis(ax: plt.Axes, *, x_grid: bool = False, y_grid: bool = True) -> None:
    """Backward-compatible wrapper for the shared axis treatment."""

    finish_rr_axis(ax, x_grid=x_grid, y_grid=y_grid)


def save_analysis_figure(
    fig: plt.Figure,
    filename: str | None = None,
    *,
    output_dir: Path = OUTPUT_DIR,
    key: str | None = None,
    builder: str | None = None,
    scope: str = "analysis",
    manuscript_asset_name: str | None = None,
    pdf_companion: bool = True,
    dpi: int = 300,
) -> Path | None:
    """Save an analysis figure, optionally register it, then display and close it."""

    output_path = None
    if filename:
        output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output_path = output_dir / filename
        fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
        formats = [output_path.suffix.lstrip(".")]
        if pdf_companion and output_path.suffix.lower() == ".png":
            pdf_path = output_path.with_suffix(".pdf")
            fig.savefig(pdf_path, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
            formats.append("pdf")
        if key and builder:
            register_export(
                key=key,
                output_path=output_path,
                builder=builder,
                artifact_kind="figure",
                scope=scope,
                formats=formats,
                manuscript_asset_name=manuscript_asset_name,
            )
    plt.show()
    plt.close(fig)
    return output_path


def save_and_render_figure(
    fig: plt.Figure,
    key: str,
    *,
    alias_keys: list[str] | None = None,
    dpi: int = 300,
    bbox_inches: str = "tight",
    facecolor: str = "white",
) -> Path:
    """Save a registered figure artifact and emit it into the rendered notebook."""

    output_path, scope, manuscript_asset_name = resolve_export_target(key)

    def _save_one(destination_key: str, destination_path: Path) -> None:
        if destination_path.suffix.lower() not in {".png", ".pdf"}:
            raise ValueError(f"Figure key '{destination_key}' must resolve to a .png or .pdf artifact.")
        destination_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        fig.savefig(destination_path, dpi=dpi, bbox_inches=bbox_inches, facecolor=facecolor)
        formats = [destination_path.suffix.lstrip(".")]
        if destination_path.suffix.lower() == ".png":
            pdf_path = destination_path.with_suffix(".pdf")
            fig.savefig(pdf_path, bbox_inches=bbox_inches, facecolor=facecolor)
            formats.append("pdf")
        _, destination_scope, destination_asset_name = resolve_export_target(destination_key)
        register_export(
            key=destination_key,
            output_path=destination_path,
            builder=f"save_and_render_figure::{key}",
            artifact_kind="figure",
            scope=destination_scope,
            formats=formats,
            manuscript_asset_name=destination_asset_name,
        )

    if output_path.suffix.lower() not in {".png", ".pdf"}:
        raise ValueError(f"Figure key '{key}' must resolve to a .png or .pdf artifact.")
    _save_one(key, output_path)
    for alias_key in alias_keys or []:
        alias_path, _, _ = resolve_export_target(alias_key)
        _save_one(alias_key, alias_path)
    plt.show()
    plt.close(fig)
    return output_path


def maybe_series(df: pd.DataFrame, candidates: list[str]) -> pd.Series:
    """Return the first available column from a candidate list or all-NaN."""

    for column in candidates:
        if column in df.columns:
            return df[column].copy()
    return pd.Series(np.nan, index=df.index, dtype="object")


def maybe_numeric(df: pd.DataFrame, candidates: list[str]) -> pd.Series:
    """Return the first available candidate column coerced to numeric."""

    return pd.to_numeric(maybe_series(df, candidates), errors="coerce")


def maybe_datetime(df: pd.DataFrame, candidates: list[str]) -> pd.Series:
    """Return the first available candidate column coerced to datetime."""

    return pd.to_datetime(maybe_series(df, candidates), errors="coerce")


def format_median_iqr(series: pd.Series, decimals: int = 1) -> str:
    """Format a numeric series as median [IQR] or N/A when empty."""

    values = pd.to_numeric(series, errors="coerce").dropna()
    if values.empty:
        return "N/A"
    median = values.median()
    q1 = values.quantile(0.25)
    q3 = values.quantile(0.75)
    return f"{median:.{decimals}f} [{q1:.{decimals}f}-{q3:.{decimals}f}]"


def format_count_pct(count: int, total: int) -> str:
    """Format n (%) with a safe zero-total guard."""

    if total == 0:
        return "0 (0.0%)"
    return f"{count:,} ({count / total * 100:.1f}%)"


def format_count_pct_no_commas(count: int, total: int) -> str:
    """Format n (%) without thousands separators for manuscript tables."""

    if total == 0:
        return "0 (0.0%)"
    return f"{count} ({count / total * 100:.1f}%)"


def hours_between(end: pd.Series, start: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Compute elapsed hours between two datetime series."""

    return (end - start).dt.total_seconds() / 3600


def ordered_categories(values: list[str], preferred_order: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Keep preferred order first and append remaining categories deterministically."""

    ordered = [value for value in preferred_order if value in values]
    ordered.extend(value for value in values if value not in ordered)
    return ordered


def ordered_rfv_display_categories(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Order displayed RFV groups by the manuscript's fixed category sequence."""

    return ordered_categories([value for value in values if pd.notna(value)], list(RFV_GROUP_ORDER))


def format_figure_n(value: object) -> str:
    """Format a figure-embedded count without thousands separators."""

    numeric_value = pd.to_numeric(pd.Series([value]), errors="coerce").iloc[0]
    if pd.isna(numeric_value):
        return "0"
    return str(int(round(float(numeric_value))))


def format_figure_pct(value: object) -> str:
    """Format a figure-embedded percentage with one decimal place."""

    numeric_value = pd.to_numeric(pd.Series([value]), errors="coerce").iloc[0]
    if pd.isna(numeric_value):
        numeric_value = 0.0
    return f"{float(numeric_value):.1f}%"


def rfv_display_color(category: str) -> str:
    """Return the color-blind-safe publication palette color for an RFV display category."""

    if category in RFV_CATEGORY_COLORS:
        return RFV_CATEGORY_COLORS[category]
    try:
        grouped_category = normalize_rfv_group(category)
    except ValueError:
        return ANALYSIS_COLORS["neutral"]
    return RFV_CATEGORY_COLORS.get(grouped_category, ANALYSIS_COLORS["neutral"])


def prevalence_lollipop_xmax(
    plot_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    minimum: float = 45.0,
    padding: float = 10.0,
    cap: float | None = None,
) -> float:
    """Return a compact x-axis limit with room for direct value labels."""

    max_value = float(plot_df.max(numeric_only=True).max())
    if not np.isfinite(max_value):
        max_value = 0.0
    x_max = max(minimum, float(np.ceil((max_value + padding) / 5.0) * 5.0))
    if cap is not None:
        x_max = min(float(cap), x_max)
    return x_max


def readable_text_color_for_cmap_value(
    value: float,
    *,
    cmap_name: str,
    vmin: float = 0.0,
    vmax: float = 100.0,
) -> str:
    """Return dark or white text after checking the actual colormap luminance."""

    if vmax <= vmin:
        normalized_value = 0.0
    else:
        normalized_value = (float(value) - vmin) / (vmax - vmin)
    normalized_value = float(np.clip(normalized_value, 0.0, 1.0))
    red, green, blue, _ = plt.get_cmap(cmap_name)(normalized_value)
    relative_luminance = (0.2126 * red) + (0.7152 * green) + (0.0722 * blue)
    return ANALYSIS_COLORS["dark"] if relative_luminance >= 0.52 else "white"


def maybe_order_rfv_categories(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Use the RFV display order when all values are grouped RFV categories."""

    value_list = [value for value in values if pd.notna(value)]
    if set(value_list).issubset(set(RFV_GROUP_ORDER)):
        return ordered_rfv_display_categories(value_list)
    return value_list


def get_figure_size(
    key: str | None = None,
    *,
    double_column: bool | None = None,
    height: float | None = None,
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Return the standard manuscript figure size."""

    if double_column is None and key is not None:
        export_type = FIGURE_SPECS.get(key, {}).get("export_type", "single-column")
        double_column = export_type == "double-column"
    width, default_height = (
        ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["double_column"]
        if bool(double_column)
        else ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["single_column"]
    )
    return width, height or default_height


def add_bar_hatches(ax: plt.Axes, hatches: list[str]) -> None:
    """Apply deterministic hatching across bar artists for grayscale-safe reading."""

    for index, patch in enumerate(ax.patches):
        patch.set_hatch(hatches[index % len(hatches)])


def plot_panelled_lollipop(
    plot_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    facet_order: list[str],
    category_order: list[str],
    title: str,
    x_label: str,
    filename: str | None = None,
    panel_titles: dict[str, str] | None = None,
) -> Path | None:
    """Render one small-multiple lollipop comparison figure."""

    category_order = maybe_order_rfv_categories(category_order)
    n_panels = len(facet_order)
    ncols = min(3, n_panels)
    nrows = int(np.ceil(n_panels / ncols))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        nrows,
        ncols,
        figsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["double_column"],
        sharex=True,
        sharey=False,
    )
    axes = np.atleast_1d(axes).ravel()
    max_value = max(35.0, float(plot_df.reindex(index=facet_order, columns=category_order, fill_value=0).max().max()) + 6.0)

    for axis_index, facet in enumerate(facet_order):
        axis = axes[axis_index]
        series = plot_df.loc[facet, category_order].reindex(category_order[::-1]).fillna(0)
        y_positions = np.arange(len(series))
        axis.hlines(y=y_positions, xmin=0, xmax=series.to_numpy(), color=ANALYSIS_COLORS["neutral_light"], linewidth=2.0)
        for category, x_value, y_value in zip(series.index, series.to_numpy(), y_positions, strict=False):
            axis.plot(
                x_value,
                y_value,
                linestyle="none",
                marker=SERIES_MARKERS.get(category, "o"),
                color=rfv_display_color(category),
                markersize=6.5,
            )
            axis.text(
                x_value + 0.5,
                y_value,
                format_figure_pct(x_value),
                va="center",
                ha="left",
                fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"],
            )
        axis.set_title(panel_titles.get(facet, facet) if panel_titles else facet, fontweight="normal")
        axis.set_xlim(0, max_value)
        axis.set_xlabel("")
        finish_axis(axis, x_grid=True, y_grid=False)
        if axis_index % ncols == 0:
            axis.set_yticks(y_positions)
            axis.set_yticklabels(series.index)
        else:
            axis.set_yticks(y_positions)
            axis.set_yticklabels([])

    for axis in axes[n_panels:]:
        axis.axis("off")

    fig.supxlabel(x_label, y=0.03, fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["label_size"])
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.23, right=0.98, top=0.94, bottom=0.11, wspace=0.18, hspace=0.28)
    return save_analysis_figure(fig, filename)


def draw_flow_box(
    ax: plt.Axes,
    *,
    center_x: float,
    center_y: float,
    width: float,
    height: float,
    text: str,
    facecolor: str = "#ffffff",
    edgecolor: str | None = None,
    linewidth: float = 0.9,
    fontsize: float = 10.0,
    fontweight: str | None = None,
    color: str | None = None,
    linespacing: float = 1.05,
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Draw a rounded flow box with explicit data-coordinate edges."""

    edgecolor = edgecolor or ANALYSIS_COLORS["light"]
    color = color or ANALYSIS_COLORS["dark"]
    left = center_x - width / 2
    bottom = center_y - height / 2
    patch = FancyBboxPatch(
        (left, bottom),
        width,
        height,
        boxstyle="round,pad=0.02,rounding_size=0.12",
        facecolor=facecolor,
        edgecolor=edgecolor,
        linewidth=linewidth,
        mutation_aspect=1,
    )
    ax.add_patch(patch)
    ax.text(
        center_x,
        center_y,
        text,
        ha="center",
        va="center",
        fontsize=fontsize,
        fontweight=fontweight,
        color=color,
        linespacing=linespacing,
    )
    return {
        "left": left,
        "right": left + width,
        "bottom": bottom,
        "top": bottom + height,
        "center_x": center_x,
        "center_y": center_y,
        "width": width,
        "height": height,
    }


def flow_box_edge(box: dict[str, float], side: str, *, x_fraction: float = 0.5, y_fraction: float = 0.5) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Return a point on a flow-box border in data coordinates."""

    if side == "top":
        return (box["left"] + box["width"] * x_fraction, box["top"])
    if side == "bottom":
        return (box["left"] + box["width"] * x_fraction, box["bottom"])
    if side == "left":
        return (box["left"], box["bottom"] + box["height"] * y_fraction)
    if side == "right":
        return (box["right"], box["bottom"] + box["height"] * y_fraction)
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported flow-box side: {side}")


def draw_flow_arrow_between_boxes(
    ax: plt.Axes,
    source_box: dict[str, float],
    target_box: dict[str, float],
    *,
    source_side: str = "bottom",
    target_side: str = "top",
    source_x_fraction: float = 0.5,
    target_x_fraction: float = 0.5,
    source_y_fraction: float = 0.5,
    target_y_fraction: float = 0.5,
    arrow_props: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Draw an arrow that starts and ends on explicit flow-box borders."""

    props = {
        "arrowstyle": "->",
        "lw": 0.9,
        "color": ANALYSIS_COLORS["mid"],
        "shrinkA": 0,
        "shrinkB": 0,
        "mutation_scale": 9,
    }
    if arrow_props:
        props.update(arrow_props)
    ax.annotate(
        "",
        xy=flow_box_edge(target_box, target_side, x_fraction=target_x_fraction, y_fraction=target_y_fraction),
        xytext=flow_box_edge(source_box, source_side, x_fraction=source_x_fraction, y_fraction=source_y_fraction),
        arrowprops=props,
    )


def draw_nlp_workflow_panel(
    ax: plt.Axes,
    *,
    classified_admissions_n: int,
    unique_cats: int,
    panel_title: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Draw the chief-concern NLP classification workflow panel onto ``ax``."""

    ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
    ax.set_ylim(0, 12)
    ax.axis("off")
    strip_style = dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.32", facecolor="#f2f4f7", edgecolor=ANALYSIS_COLORS["light"], lw=0.9)

    if panel_title:
        ax.text(0.03, 0.98, panel_title, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=12.5, fontweight="bold", va="top", bbox=strip_style)

    workflow_steps = [
        "Triage chief\ncomplaint field",
        "Normalize and\nsegment text",
        "Embed fragments",
        "Score against\nNHAMCS RFV prototypes",
        "Apply deterministic\noverrides",
        "Assign up to five\nRFV categories per admission",
    ]
    y_positions = [10.35, 9.05, 7.75, 6.45, 5.15, 3.85]
    workflow_boxes = [
        draw_flow_box(
            ax,
            center_x=5,
            center_y=y_position,
            width=4.65,
            height=0.92,
            text=step,
            facecolor="#ffffff",
            edgecolor=ANALYSIS_COLORS["light"],
            fontsize=9.8,
        )
        for step, y_position in zip(workflow_steps, y_positions, strict=True)
    ]

    for source_box, target_box in zip(workflow_boxes[:-1], workflow_boxes[1:], strict=True):
        draw_flow_arrow_between_boxes(ax, source_box, target_box)

    final_box = draw_flow_box(
        ax,
        center_x=5,
        center_y=1.55,
        width=6.8,
        height=1.50,
        text=(
            "Final classified cohort\n"
            f"{format_figure_n(unique_cats)} NHAMCS RFV categories\n"
            f"N={format_figure_n(classified_admissions_n)} admissions"
        ),
        facecolor="#f2f4f7",
        edgecolor=ANALYSIS_COLORS["accent"],
        linewidth=1.0,
        fontsize=9.5,
        fontweight="bold",
    )
    draw_flow_arrow_between_boxes(ax, workflow_boxes[-1], final_box)


def draw_ascertainment_flow_panel(

        ax,

        height=0.70,

        facecolor="#f8f9fa",
        edgecolor=ANALYSIS_COLORS["light"],
        linewidth=0.6,
        fontsize=9.6,
        fontweight="bold",
    )
    route_boxes = [
        draw_flow_box(
            ax,
            center_x=2.0,

            height=1.05,

        draw_flow_box(

            height=1.05,

            edgecolor=ANALYSIS_COLORS["mid"],
            fontsize=10.0,
        ),
        draw_flow_box(
            ax,
            center_x=8.0,
            center_y=2.40,
            width=2.2,
            height=1.05,
            text=f"ICD-only\nn={format_figure_n(icd_only_n)}",
            facecolor="#f8f9fa",
            edgecolor=ANALYSIS_COLORS["mid"],
            fontsize=10.0,
        ),
    ]
    for target_box, source_fraction in zip(route_boxes, (0.16, 0.5, 0.84), strict=True):
        draw_flow_arrow_between_boxes(
            ax,
            stratum_header,
            target_box,
            source_x_fraction=source_fraction,
        )


SOURCE_OVERLAP_SOURCES = ["ABG", "VBG", "ICD", "UNKNOWN"]
SOURCE_OVERLAP_FLAG_COLUMNS = {
    "ABG": "abg_hypercap_threshold",
    "VBG": "vbg_hypercap_threshold",
    "ICD": "any_hypercap_icd",
    "UNKNOWN": "unknown_hypercap_threshold",
}
SOURCE_OVERLAP_MATRIX_COLUMNS = {
    "ABG": "ABG-positive",
    "VBG": "VBG-positive",
    "ICD": "ICD-positive",
    "UNKNOWN": "UNKNOWN-positive",
}
SOURCE_OVERLAP_DISPLAY_LABELS = {
    "ABG": "ABG",
    "VBG": "VBG",
    "ICD": "ICD",
    "UNKNOWN": "UNKNOWN gas",
}


def format_source_specific_overlap_label(row: pd.Series) -> str:
    """Return a non-ambiguous label for one source-specific overlap row."""

    active_sources = [source for source in SOURCE_OVERLAP_SOURCES if bool(row[source])]
    if active_sources == ["ICD"]:
        return "ICD + no gas"
    if active_sources == ["UNKNOWN"]:
        return "Indeterminate gas only"
    if len(active_sources) == 1:
        return f"{SOURCE_OVERLAP_DISPLAY_LABELS[active_sources[0]]} only"
    if not active_sources:
        return "No qualifying source"
    return " + ".join(SOURCE_OVERLAP_DISPLAY_LABELS[source] for source in active_sources)


def build_source_specific_overlap_intersections(cohort_df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Build ABG/VBG/ICD/UNKNOWN-source gas intersections for display and export."""

    flags = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            source: to_binary_flag(maybe_series(cohort_df, [flag_column])).astype(bool)
            for source, flag_column in SOURCE_OVERLAP_FLAG_COLUMNS.items()
        },
        index=cohort_df.index,
    )
    intersections = (
        flags.groupby(SOURCE_OVERLAP_SOURCES, dropna=False)
        .size()
        .reset_index(name="Count")
        .loc[lambda data: data["Count"].gt(0)]
        .sort_values(["Count"], ascending=[False])
        .reset_index(drop=True)
    )
    intersections["intersection_label"] = intersections.apply(format_source_specific_overlap_label, axis=1)
    intersections = intersections.sort_values(["Count", "intersection_label"], ascending=[False, True]).reset_index(drop=True)
    intersections["sort_rank"] = np.arange(1, len(intersections) + 1)
    intersections["count"] = intersections["Count"].astype(int)
    for source, matrix_column in SOURCE_OVERLAP_MATRIX_COLUMNS.items():
        intersections[matrix_column] = intersections[source].astype(int)
    return intersections


def build_source_specific_overlap_set_sizes(intersections: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Summarize displayed source-set sizes from the source-specific intersection table."""

    return pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "source": source,
                "set_label": SOURCE_OVERLAP_MATRIX_COLUMNS[source],
                "display_label": SOURCE_OVERLAP_DISPLAY_LABELS[source],
                "count": int(intersections.loc[intersections[source].astype(bool), "Count"].sum()),
            }
            for source in SOURCE_OVERLAP_SOURCES
        ]
    )


def render_manuscript_prevalence_panels(
    plot_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    facet_order: list[str],
    category_order: list[str],
    group_sizes: dict[str, int],
    key: str,
    ci_lower_df: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    ci_upper_df: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    alias_keys: list[str] | None = None,
    title: str,
    facet_label_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    facet_strip_label_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    highlight_categories: set[str] | None = None,
    highlight_color: str = ANALYSIS_COLORS["accent"],
    x_max: float,
    y_label: str = "Grouped presenting-concern category",
    strip_text: str | None = None,
    muted_marks: bool = False,
    emphasize_ci: bool = False,
    height: float = 6.1,
) -> Path:
    """Render one manuscript prevalence figure with consistent category order and x-limits."""

    category_order = ordered_rfv_display_categories(category_order)
    plot_matrix_for_limits = plot_df.reindex(index=facet_order, columns=category_order).fillna(0)
    label_x_padding = 2.0
    label_bound_max = float(plot_matrix_for_limits.max(numeric_only=True).max())
    ci_max = None
    if ci_upper_df is not None and not ci_upper_df.empty:
        ci_max = float(
            ci_upper_df.reindex(index=facet_order, columns=category_order)
            .max(numeric_only=True)
            .max()
        )
        if np.isfinite(ci_max):
            label_bound_max = max(label_bound_max, ci_max)
    if np.isfinite(label_bound_max):
        x_max = max(x_max, float(np.ceil((label_bound_max + label_x_padding + 5.0) / 5.0) * 5.0))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(facet_order), figsize=get_figure_size(key, height=height), sharex=True, sharey=True)
    axes = np.atleast_1d(axes).ravel()
    for axis_index, facet in enumerate(facet_order):
        axis = axes[axis_index]
        facet_values = plot_df.loc[facet, category_order].reindex(category_order[::-1]).fillna(0)
        if ci_lower_df is not None and ci_upper_df is not None:
            lower_values = ci_lower_df.loc[facet, category_order].reindex(category_order[::-1]).fillna(facet_values)
            upper_values = ci_upper_df.loc[facet, category_order].reindex(category_order[::-1]).fillna(facet_values)
        else:
            lower_values = upper_values = None
        y_positions = np.arange(len(facet_values))
        stem_linewidth = 1.2 if emphasize_ci else 2.2
        stem_alpha = 0.65 if emphasize_ci else 1.0
        axis.hlines(
            y=y_positions,
            xmin=0,
            xmax=facet_values.to_numpy(),
            color=ANALYSIS_COLORS["neutral_light"],
            linewidth=stem_linewidth,
            alpha=stem_alpha,
            zorder=1,
        )
        if lower_values is not None and upper_values is not None:
            values = facet_values.to_numpy(dtype=float)
            xerr = np.vstack(
                [
                    np.maximum(values - lower_values.to_numpy(dtype=float), 0.0),
                    np.maximum(upper_values.to_numpy(dtype=float) - values, 0.0),
                ]
            )
            axis.errorbar(
                values,
                y_positions,
                xerr=xerr,
                fmt="none",
                ecolor=ANALYSIS_COLORS["mid"],
                elinewidth=1.4 if emphasize_ci else 0.9,
                capsize=3.2 if emphasize_ci else 2.4,
                capthick=1.1 if emphasize_ci else 0.9,
                zorder=3,
            )
        for category, y_pos, value in zip(facet_values.index, y_positions, facet_values.to_numpy(), strict=False):
            is_highlighted = highlight_categories is not None and category in highlight_categories
            if muted_marks:
                point_color = ANALYSIS_COLORS["neutral"]
            else:
                point_color = rfv_display_color(category)
            axis.plot(
                value,
                y_pos,
                linestyle="none",
                marker=SERIES_MARKERS.get(category, "o"),
                markersize=7.0 if is_highlighted else 6.5,
                color=point_color,
                zorder=4,
            )
            label_anchor = value
            if upper_values is not None:
                label_anchor = max(label_anchor, float(upper_values.loc[category]))
            axis.text(
                label_anchor + label_x_padding,
                y_pos,
                format_figure_pct(value),
                va="center",
                ha="left",
                fontsize=FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"],
                color=ANALYSIS_COLORS["dark"],
                bbox={
                    "boxstyle": "round,pad=0.10",
                    "facecolor": "white",
                    "edgecolor": "none",
                    "alpha": 0.92,
                },
                clip_on=False,
            )
        facet_label = facet_label_map.get(facet, facet) if facet_label_map else facet
        facet_strip_label = (
            facet_strip_label_map.get(facet)
            if facet_strip_label_map and facet in facet_strip_label_map
            else f"{facet_label}\nN={format_figure_n(group_sizes.get(facet, 0))}"
        )
        axis.set_title(facet_strip_label, fontweight="normal")
        axis.set_xlim(0, x_max)
        axis.set_xlabel("")
        finish_axis(axis, x_grid=True, y_grid=False)
        axis.set_yticks(y_positions)
        if axis_index == 0:
            axis.set_yticklabels(facet_values.index)
            axis.set_ylabel(y_label)
        else:
            axis.tick_params(axis="y", labelleft=False)

    if strip_text:
        fig.text(
            0.5,
            0.965,
            strip_text,
            ha="center",
            va="center",
            fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"] + 0.5,
            color=ANALYSIS_COLORS["dark"],
            bbox={
                "boxstyle": "round,pad=0.28",
                "facecolor": "#f3f4f6",
                "edgecolor": ANALYSIS_COLORS["grid"],
                "linewidth": 0.8,
            },
        )
    fig.supxlabel("Percent of admissions", y=0.04, fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["label_size"])
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.24, right=0.98, top=0.82 if strip_text else 0.88, bottom=0.13, wspace=0.18)
    return save_and_render_figure(fig, key, alias_keys=alias_keys)


def render_age_profile_panels(
    plot_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    age_order: list[str],
    category_order: list[str],
    group_sizes: dict[str, int],
    key: str,

    ci_upper_df: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
    highlight_categories: set[str],
    y_max: float,
    height: float = 6.8,
) -> Path:
    """Render Figure 3 as category-by-age profile small multiples."""

    category_order = ordered_rfv_display_categories(category_order)
    plot_matrix = plot_df.reindex(index=age_order, columns=category_order, fill_value=0).fillna(0)
    ci_lower_matrix = None
    ci_upper_matrix = None
    if ci_lower_df is not None and ci_upper_df is not None:
        ci_lower_matrix = ci_lower_df.reindex(index=age_order, columns=category_order).fillna(plot_matrix)
        ci_upper_matrix = ci_upper_df.reindex(index=age_order, columns=category_order).fillna(plot_matrix)
        ci_max = float(ci_upper_matrix.max(numeric_only=True).max())
        if np.isfinite(ci_max):
            y_max = max(y_max, float(np.ceil((ci_max + 5.0) / 5.0) * 5.0))
    age_positions = np.arange(len(age_order))
    age_tick_labels = [f"{age_group}\nN={format_figure_n(group_sizes.get(age_group, 0))}" for age_group in age_order]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=get_figure_size(key, height=height), sharex=True, sharey=True)
    axes = np.atleast_1d(axes).ravel()
    for axis_index, category in enumerate(category_order):
        axis = axes[axis_index]
        values = plot_matrix[category].to_numpy(dtype=float)
        if ci_lower_matrix is not None and ci_upper_matrix is not None:
            lower_values = ci_lower_matrix[category].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            upper_values = ci_upper_matrix[category].to_numpy(dtype=float)
            yerr = np.vstack(
                [
                    np.maximum(values - lower_values, 0.0),
                    np.maximum(upper_values - values, 0.0),
                ]
            )
        else:
            yerr = None
        is_highlighted = category in highlight_categories
        line_color = rfv_display_color(category)
        marker_face = line_color if is_highlighted else "white"
        line_width = 2.0 if is_highlighted else 1.35
        marker_size = 5.8 if is_highlighted else 4.8

        if yerr is not None:
            axis.errorbar(
                age_positions,
                values,
                yerr=yerr,
                fmt="none",
                ecolor=ANALYSIS_COLORS["mid"],
                elinewidth=0.9,
                capsize=2.4,
                capthick=0.9,
                zorder=1,
            )

        axis.plot(
            age_positions,
            values,
            color=line_color,
            linewidth=line_width,
            marker=SERIES_MARKERS.get(category, "o"),
            markersize=marker_size,
            markerfacecolor=marker_face,
            markeredgecolor=line_color,
            markeredgewidth=1.2,
            zorder=2,
        )
        axis.set_title(category, fontweight="normal")
        axis.set_xlim(age_positions.min() - 0.25, age_positions.max() + 0.45)
        axis.set_ylim(0, y_max)
        axis.set_xticks(age_positions)
        axis.set_xticklabels(age_tick_labels)
        axis.tick_params(axis="x", labelbottom=True, pad=2)
        finish_axis(axis, x_grid=False, y_grid=True)

        label_color = line_color if is_highlighted else ANALYSIS_COLORS["dark"]
        axis.text(
            age_positions[-1] + 0.08,
            values[-1],
            format_figure_pct(values[-1]),
            va="center",
            ha="left",
            fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"],
            color=label_color,
            fontweight="bold" if is_highlighted else "normal",
            clip_on=False,
        )
        if is_highlighted:
            axis.text(
                age_positions[0] - 0.08,
                values[0],
                format_figure_pct(values[0]),
                va="center",
                ha="right",
                fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"],
                color=line_color,
                fontweight="bold",
                clip_on=False,
            )

        if axis_index % 3 != 0:
            axis.tick_params(axis="y", labelleft=False)

    fig.supxlabel("Age group, years", y=0.04, fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["label_size"])
    fig.supylabel("Percent of admissions", x=0.015, fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["label_size"])
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.975, top=0.92, bottom=0.14, wspace=0.14, hspace=0.45)
    return save_and_render_figure(fig, key)

def render_compensation_matrix_heatmap(
    matrix_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    group_order: list[str],
    group_sizes: dict[str, int],
    key: str,
    height: float = 4.8,
) -> Path:
    """Render the candidate pH-by-bicarbonate compensation matrix as a heatmap."""

    category_order = ordered_rfv_display_categories(RFV_GROUP_ORDER)
    value_matrix = matrix_df.reindex(index=category_order, columns=group_order, fill_value=0).fillna(0)
    column_label_map = {
        "Acidemic, HCO3 <28": "Acidemic\nHCO3 <28",
        "Acidemic, HCO3 ≥28": "Acidemic\nHCO3 ≥28",
        "Normal/alkalemic, HCO3 <28": "Normal/alkalemic\nHCO3 <28",
        "Normal/alkalemic, HCO3 ≥28": "Normal/alkalemic\nHCO3 ≥28",
    }
    column_labels = [
        f"{column_label_map.get(group_name, group_name)}\nN={format_figure_n(group_sizes.get(group_name, 0))}"
        for group_name in group_order
    ]
    cell_labels = value_matrix.apply(lambda column: column.map(format_figure_pct))
    compensation_matrix_cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
        "candidate_compensation_matrix_blue",
        ["#F4F7FC", "#CEDFFE", "#A3BEFA", "#5477C4", "#2E4780"],
    )
    vmax = max(55.0, float(np.nanmax(value_matrix.to_numpy(dtype=float))))

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=get_figure_size(key, height=height))
    sns.heatmap(
        value_matrix,
        ax=ax,
        cmap=compensation_matrix_cmap,
        vmin=0.0,
        vmax=vmax,
        annot=cell_labels.to_numpy(),
        fmt="",
        cbar=False,
        linewidths=0.8,
        linecolor="white",
        annot_kws={
            "fontsize": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"],
            "fontweight": "bold",
        },
    )
    ax.set_xticklabels(column_labels, rotation=0, ha="center")
    ax.set_yticklabels(value_matrix.index, rotation=0)
    ax.set_xlabel("Descriptive acid-base group")
    ax.set_ylabel("Grouped presenting-concern category")
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", length=0)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    for text, cell_value in zip(ax.texts, value_matrix.to_numpy(dtype=float).ravel(), strict=False):
        text.set_color("white" if cell_value >= 35.0 else ANALYSIS_COLORS["dark"])
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.26, right=0.98, top=0.92, bottom=0.18)
    return save_and_render_figure(fig, key)


def render_recognition_by_pco2_heatmap(
    percent_matrix: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    numerator_matrix: pd.DataFrame,
    denominator_matrix: pd.DataFrame,
    pco2_order: list[str],
    pco2_group_sizes: dict[str, int],
    key: str,
    alias_keys: list[str] | None = None,
    height: float = 5.4,
) -> Path:
    """Render ICD recognition by PCO2 stratum as a compact grouped-category matrix."""

    category_order = ordered_rfv_display_categories(RFV_GROUP_ORDER)
    value_matrix = percent_matrix.reindex(index=category_order, columns=pco2_order, fill_value=0).fillna(0)
    numerator_matrix = numerator_matrix.reindex(index=category_order, columns=pco2_order, fill_value=0).fillna(0)
    denominator_matrix = denominator_matrix.reindex(index=category_order, columns=pco2_order, fill_value=0).fillna(0)
    column_labels = [
        f"{pco2_bin}\nN={format_figure_n(pco2_group_sizes.get(pco2_bin, 0))}"
        for pco2_bin in pco2_order
    ]
    cell_labels = value_matrix.copy().astype("object")
    for category in value_matrix.index:
        for pco2_bin in value_matrix.columns:
            denominator = int(denominator_matrix.loc[category, pco2_bin])
            numerator = int(numerator_matrix.loc[category, pco2_bin])
            if denominator == 0:
                cell_labels.loc[category, pco2_bin] = ""
            else:
                cell_labels.loc[category, pco2_bin] = (
                    f"{format_figure_pct(value_matrix.loc[category, pco2_bin])}\n"
                    f"{format_figure_n(numerator)}/{format_figure_n(denominator)}"
                )
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=get_figure_size(key, height=height))
    sns.heatmap(
        value_matrix,
        ax=ax,
        cmap="cividis",
        vmin=0.0,
        vmax=100.0,
        annot=cell_labels.to_numpy(),
        fmt="",
        cbar=False,
        linewidths=0.8,
        linecolor="white",
        annot_kws={
            "fontsize": ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"] - 0.5,
            "fontweight": "bold",
        },
    )
    ax.set_xticklabels(column_labels, rotation=0, ha="center")
    ax.set_yticklabels(value_matrix.index, rotation=0)
    ax.set_xlabel("Qualifying PCO2 stratum")
    ax.set_ylabel("Grouped presenting-concern category")
    ax.tick_params(axis="both", length=0)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_visible(False)
    for text, cell_value in zip(ax.texts, value_matrix.to_numpy(dtype=float).ravel(), strict=False):
        text.set_color(readable_text_color_for_cmap_value(cell_value, cmap_name="cividis"))
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.25, right=0.985, top=0.92, bottom=0.15)
    return save_and_render_figure(fig, key, alias_keys=alias_keys)


def direct_label_lines(
    ax: plt.Axes,
    x_positions: np.ndarray,
    series_specs: list[dict[str, object]],
    *,
    x_pad: float = 0.3,
) -> None:
    """Label the final visible point of each line directly on the plotting area."""

    valid_specs: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for spec in series_specs:
        y_values = np.asarray(spec["y_values"], dtype=float)
        valid_idx = np.where(np.isfinite(y_values))[0]
        if len(valid_idx) == 0:
            continue
        last_idx = int(valid_idx[-1])
        valid_specs.append(
            {
                "label": str(spec["label"]),
                "color": str(spec["color"]),
                "x_value": float(x_positions[last_idx]),
                "y_value": float(y_values[last_idx]),
            }
        )

    if not valid_specs:
        return

    y_min, y_max = ax.get_ylim()
    min_gap = max((y_max - y_min) * 0.05, 1.0)
    valid_specs = sorted(valid_specs, key=lambda item: item["y_value"])
    last_y = None
    for spec in valid_specs:
        adjusted_y = spec["y_value"]
        if last_y is not None and adjusted_y - last_y < min_gap:
            adjusted_y = last_y + min_gap
        spec["adjusted_y"] = adjusted_y
        last_y = adjusted_y

    ax.set_xlim(x_positions.min() - 0.15, x_positions.max() + x_pad + 0.25)
    for spec in valid_specs:
        ax.plot(
            [spec["x_value"], spec["x_value"] + x_pad * 0.7],
            [spec["y_value"], spec["adjusted_y"]],
            color=spec["color"],
            linewidth=1.0,
        )
        ax.text(
            spec["x_value"] + x_pad,
            spec["adjusted_y"],
            spec["label"],
            color=spec["color"],
            fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"],
            va="center",
            ha="left",
            fontweight="bold",
            bbox={"facecolor": "white", "edgecolor": "none", "pad": 0.2},
        )


def plot_forest_axis(
    axis: plt.Axes,
    forest_df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    x_label: str = "Odds ratio (95% CI)",
    label_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    color: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Draw one compact forest plot with numeric odds-ratio annotations."""

    forest_df = forest_df.copy().drop(index="Intercept", errors="ignore")
    if label_map is not None:
        forest_df.index = forest_df.index.map(lambda value: label_map.get(value, value))
    interval_low = "CI_lo" if "CI_lo" in forest_df.columns else "LCI"
    interval_high = "CI_hi" if "CI_hi" in forest_df.columns else "UCI"
    forest_df = forest_df.dropna(subset=["OR", interval_low, interval_high])
    draw_color = color or ANALYSIS_COLORS["dark"]
    y_positions = np.arange(len(forest_df))
    axis.errorbar(
        forest_df["OR"],
        y_positions,
        xerr=[forest_df["OR"] - forest_df[interval_low], forest_df[interval_high] - forest_df["OR"]],
        fmt="o",
        color=draw_color,
        ecolor=draw_color,
        capsize=4,
        markersize=7,
        linewidth=1.6,
    )
    axis.axvline(1, color=ANALYSIS_COLORS["mid"], linestyle="--", linewidth=1.1)
    axis.set_yticks(y_positions)
    axis.set_yticklabels(forest_df.index)
    axis.invert_yaxis()
    axis.set_xscale("log")
    axis.set_xlabel(x_label)
    axis.set_title(title)
    finish_axis(axis, x_grid=True, y_grid=False)

    x_right = float(forest_df[interval_high].max()) * 2.15
    x_left = max(float(forest_df[interval_low].min()) * 0.85, 0.1)
    axis.set_xlim(x_left, x_right)
    for y_pos, (_, row) in zip(y_positions, forest_df.iterrows(), strict=False):
        axis.text(
            float(row[interval_high]) * 1.12,
            y_pos,
            f'{row["OR"]:.2f} [{row[interval_low]:.2f}, {row[interval_high]:.2f}]',
            va="center",
            ha="left",
            fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["annotation_size"],
        )


def write_figure_manifest(denominator_map: dict[str, int]) -> Path:
    """Write one manuscript-aware figure manifest from the unified figure specs."""

    rows = []
    for key, spec in FIGURE_SPECS.items():
        output_path, scope, manuscript_asset_name = resolve_export_target(key)
        pdf_path = output_path.with_suffix(".pdf") if output_path.suffix.lower() == ".png" else output_path
        rows.append(
            {
                "figure_key": key,
                "scope": scope,
                "output_filename": output_path.name,
                "pdf_filename": pdf_path.name if pdf_path.suffix.lower() == ".pdf" else "",
                "title": spec["title"],
                "caption_stub": spec["caption_stub"],
                "cohort_denominator_n": int(denominator_map.get(key, 0)),
                "comparison_statement": spec["comparison_statement"],
                "order_rule": spec["order_rule"],
                "export_type": spec["export_type"],
                "manuscript_asset_name": manuscript_asset_name,
                "output_exists": output_path.exists(),
                "pdf_exists": pdf_path.exists(),
            }
        )
    manifest_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    manifest_path, _, _ = resolve_export_target("figure_manifest")
    manifest_df.to_csv(manifest_path, index=False)
    register_export(
        key="figure_manifest",
        output_path=manifest_path,
        builder="write_figure_manifest",
        artifact_kind="manifest",
        scope="secondary",
        formats=["csv"],
    )
    return manifest_path

def submission_asset_spec(
    source_filename: str,
    *,
    file_name: str,
    manuscript_label: str,
    main_or_supplement: str,
    title: str,
    intended_caption: str,
    asset_type: str,
    source_data_file: str = SUBMISSION_CANONICAL_SOURCE_DATA_FILE,
    include_in_submission: bool = True,
    conversion: str = "",
    required_asset: bool = True,
    producer_stage: str = "analysis",
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Create one submission-bundle asset contract row."""

    return {
        "source_filename": source_filename,
        "file_name": file_name,
        "manuscript_label": manuscript_label,
        "title": title,
        "main_or_supplement": main_or_supplement,
        "source_notebook": SUBMISSION_SOURCE_NOTEBOOK,
        "source_data_file": source_data_file,
        "intended_caption": intended_caption,
        "include_in_submission": "TRUE" if include_in_submission else "FALSE",
        "asset_type": asset_type,
        "conversion": conversion,
        "required_asset": required_asset,
        "producer_stage": producer_stage,
    }


def submission_figure_metadata(manuscript_label: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Return title and caption text for one figure label."""

    figure_key = SUBMISSION_LABEL_TO_FIGURE_KEY[manuscript_label]
    spec = FIGURE_SPECS[figure_key]
    return str(spec["title"]), str(spec["caption_stub"])
