```{python}
    """Return the explicit clean submission-asset bundle contract."""

    main_display_assets = [
        ("Figure 1.pdf", "Figure_1.pdf", "Figure 1", "figure", ""),
        ("Figure 1.pdf", "Figure_1.png", "Figure 1", "figure", "pdf_to_png"),
        ("Figure 2.pdf", "Figure_2.pdf", "Figure 2", "figure", ""),
        ("Figure 2.png", "Figure_2.png", "Figure 2", "figure", ""),
        ("Figure 3.pdf", "Figure_3.pdf", "Figure 3", "figure", ""),
        ("Figure 3.png", "Figure_3.png", "Figure 3", "figure", ""),
        ("Figure 4.pdf", "Figure_4.pdf", "Figure 4", "figure", ""),
        ("Figure 4.png", "Figure_4.png", "Figure 4", "figure", ""),
        ("Table 1.xlsx", "Table_1_submission.xlsx", "Table 1", "table", ""),
        ("Table 2.xlsx", "Table_2_submission.xlsx", "Table 2", "table", ""),
    ]
    supplement_display_assets = [
        ("Figure S1.pdf", "Figure_S1.pdf", "Figure S1", "figure"),
        ("Figure S1.png", "Figure_S1.png", "Figure S1", "figure"),
        ("Figure S2.pdf", "Figure_S2.pdf", "Figure S2", "figure"),
        ("Figure S2.png", "Figure_S2.png", "Figure S2", "figure"),
        ("Figure S3.pdf", "Figure_S3.pdf", "Figure S3", "figure"),
        ("Figure S3.png", "Figure_S3.png", "Figure S3", "figure"),
        ("Figure S4.pdf", "Figure_S4.pdf", "Figure S4", "figure"),
        ("Figure S4.png", "Figure_S4.png", "Figure S4", "figure"),
        ("Figure S5.pdf", "Figure_S5.pdf", "Figure S5", "figure"),
        ("Figure S5.png", "Figure_S5.png", "Figure S5", "figure"),
        ("Figure S6.pdf", "Figure_S6.pdf", "Figure S6", "figure"),
        ("Figure S6.png", "Figure_S6.png", "Figure S6", "figure"),
        ("Figure S7.pdf", "Figure_S7.pdf", "Figure S7", "figure"),
        ("Figure S7.png", "Figure_S7.png", "Figure S7", "figure"),
        ("Figure S8.pdf", "Figure_S8.pdf", "Figure S8", "figure"),
        ("Figure S8.png", "Figure_S8.png", "Figure S8", "figure"),
        ("Figure S9.pdf", "Figure_S9.pdf", "Figure S9", "figure"),
        ("Figure S9.png", "Figure_S9.png", "Figure S9", "figure"),
        ("Table S1.xlsx", "Supplementary_Table_S1.xlsx", "Supplementary Table S1", "table"),
    ]

    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for source_filename, file_name, manuscript_label, asset_type, conversion in main_display_assets:
        if asset_type == "figure":
            title, intended_caption = submission_figure_metadata(manuscript_label)
        else:
            table_spec = SUBMISSION_TABLE_SPECS[manuscript_label]
            title = table_spec["title"]
            intended_caption = table_spec["intended_caption"]
        rows.append(
            submission_asset_spec(
                source_filename,
                file_name=file_name,
                manuscript_label=manuscript_label,
                main_or_supplement="main",
                title=title,
                intended_caption=intended_caption,
                asset_type=asset_type,
                conversion=conversion,
            )
        )
    for source_filename, file_name, manuscript_label, asset_type in supplement_display_assets:
        if asset_type == "figure":
            title, intended_caption = submission_figure_metadata(manuscript_label)
        else:
            table_spec = SUBMISSION_TABLE_SPECS[manuscript_label]
            title = table_spec["title"]
            intended_caption = table_spec["intended_caption"]
        rows.append(
            submission_asset_spec(
                source_filename,
                file_name=file_name,
                manuscript_label=manuscript_label,
                main_or_supplement="supplement",
                title=title,
                intended_caption=intended_caption,
                asset_type=asset_type,
                required_asset=source_filename != "Table S1.xlsx",
            )
        )
    return rows


def validate_submission_asset_bundle(
    bundle_dir: Path,
    manifest_df: pd.DataFrame,
    missing_optional_df: pd.DataFrame | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Validate that the submission bundle contains only clean allowlisted assets."""

    required_columns = {
        "file_name",
        "manuscript_label",
        "title",
        "main_or_supplement",
        "source_notebook",
        "source_data_file",
        "intended_caption",
        "include_in_submission",
    }
    missing_columns = sorted(required_columns.difference(manifest_df.columns))
    if missing_columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Submission asset manifest missing columns: {missing_columns}")

    included_manifest = manifest_df.loc[
        manifest_df["include_in_submission"].astype(str).str.upper().eq("TRUE")
    ].copy()
    expected_files = set(included_manifest["file_name"].astype(str))
    actual_files = {path.name for path in bundle_dir.iterdir() if path.is_file()}
    expected_with_manifest = expected_files | {SUBMISSION_ASSET_MANIFEST_FILENAME}
    if actual_files != expected_with_manifest:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"submission_assets file mismatch: expected {sorted(expected_with_manifest)}, got {sorted(actual_files)}"
        )

    missing_required_files = sorted(SUBMISSION_REQUIRED_FILENAMES.difference(expected_files))
    if missing_required_files:
        raise AssertionError(f"submission_assets missing required files: {missing_required_files}")

    manifest_destinations = manifest_df["file_name"].astype(str)
    if manifest_destinations.duplicated().any():
        duplicates = sorted(manifest_destinations.loc[manifest_destinations.duplicated()].unique().tolist())
        raise ValueError(f"Submission asset manifest has duplicate destinations: {duplicates}")

    forbidden_pattern = re.compile("|".join(SUBMISSION_FORBIDDEN_ASSET_PATTERNS), flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    forbidden_hits = sorted(filename for filename in expected_files if forbidden_pattern.search(filename))
    if forbidden_hits:
        raise AssertionError(f"submission_assets contains forbidden exploratory outputs: {forbidden_hits}")

    hidden_or_archive_hits = sorted(
        path.name
        for path in bundle_dir.rglob("*")
        if "__MACOSX" in path.parts or path.name.startswith("._") or path.name == ".DS_Store"
    )
    if hidden_or_archive_hits:
        raise AssertionError(f"submission_assets contains hidden or macOS archive files: {hidden_or_archive_hits}")

    allowed_sections = {"main", "supplement"}
    unsupported_sections = sorted(set(manifest_df["main_or_supplement"]).difference(allowed_sections))
    if unsupported_sections:
        raise ValueError(f"Submission asset manifest has unsupported sections: {unsupported_sections}")

    blank_required_fields = []
    for column in ["file_name", "manuscript_label", "title", "intended_caption"]:
        blank_mask = included_manifest[column].astype("string").fillna("").str.strip().eq("")
        if bool(blank_mask.any()):
            blank_required_fields.append(column)
    if blank_required_fields:
        raise ValueError(f"Included submission assets have blank required fields: {blank_required_fields}")

    if missing_optional_df is None:
        return

    optional_required_columns = {"source_filename", "producer_stage", "expected_results_dir", "reason"}
    missing_optional_columns = sorted(optional_required_columns.difference(missing_optional_df.columns))
    if missing_optional_columns:
        raise ValueError(f"Optional-missing asset audit missing columns: {missing_optional_columns}")
    if missing_optional_df.empty:
        return

    missing_optional_sources = set(missing_optional_df["source_filename"].astype(str))
    undeclared_optional_assets = sorted(missing_optional_sources.difference(SUBMISSION_OPTIONAL_UPSTREAM_FILENAMES))
    if undeclared_optional_assets:
        raise AssertionError(f"Missing optional submission assets are not declared upstream assets: {undeclared_optional_assets}")
    copied_and_missing = sorted(missing_optional_sources.intersection(set(manifest_df["source_filename"].astype(str))))
    if copied_and_missing:
        raise AssertionError(f"Submission assets cannot be both copied and missing: {copied_and_missing}")
    unexpected_reasons = sorted(
        set(missing_optional_df["reason"].astype(str)).difference({"optional_upstream_asset_missing"})
    )
    if unexpected_reasons:
        raise ValueError(f"Optional-missing asset audit has unsupported reasons: {unexpected_reasons}")


def build_submission_asset_bundle(
    output_dir: Path = OUTPUT_DIR,
) -> tuple[Path, Path, pd.DataFrame, Path | None, pd.DataFrame]:
    """Copy the clean manuscript/supplement submission asset allowlist into one directory."""

    def _copy_submission_asset(source_path: Path, destination_path: Path, conversion: str) -> None:
        if conversion == "":
            shutil.copy2(source_path, destination_path)
            return
        if conversion != "pdf_to_png":
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported submission asset conversion: {conversion}")
        if source_path.suffix.lower() != ".pdf" or destination_path.suffix.lower() != ".png":
            raise ValueError(
                f"pdf_to_png conversion requires PDF source and PNG destination, got {source_path.name} -> {destination_path.name}"
            )
        converter = shutil.which("pdftoppm")
        if converter is None:
            raise RuntimeError("pdftoppm is required to generate submission PNG assets from PDF outputs.")
        subprocess.run(
            [
                converter,
                "-singlefile",
                "-png",
                "-r",
                "300",
                str(source_path),
                str(destination_path.with_suffix("")),
            ],
            check=True,
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        if not destination_path.exists():
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"PDF-to-PNG conversion did not create expected file: {destination_path}")

    bundle_dir = output_dir / SUBMISSION_ASSET_DIRNAME
    if bundle_dir.exists() and not bundle_dir.is_dir():
        raise NotADirectoryError(f"Expected submission asset directory, found file: {bundle_dir}")
    if bundle_dir.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(bundle_dir)
    bundle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    rows = []
    missing_optional_rows = []
    for spec in build_submission_asset_allowlist():
        source_filename = str(spec["source_filename"])
        source_path = output_dir / source_filename
        if not source_path.exists():
            if bool(spec.get("required_asset", True)):
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing required allowlisted submission asset: {source_path}")
            if source_filename not in SUBMISSION_OPTIONAL_UPSTREAM_FILENAMES:
                raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing undeclared optional submission asset: {source_path}")
            missing_optional_rows.append(
                {
                    "source_filename": source_filename,
                    "producer_stage": str(spec.get("producer_stage", "")),
                    "expected_results_dir": display_path(output_dir),
                    "reason": "optional_upstream_asset_missing",
                }
            )
            continue
        destination_path = bundle_dir / str(spec["file_name"])
        if destination_path.exists():
            raise FileExistsError(f"Duplicate submission asset destination: {destination_path.name}")
        _copy_submission_asset(
            source_path,
            destination_path,
            str(spec.get("conversion", "")),
        )
        rows.append(
            {
                **spec,
                "copied_relative_path": f"{SUBMISSION_ASSET_DIRNAME}/{destination_path.name}",
                "source_relative_path": source_path.name,
                "size_bytes": int(destination_path.stat().st_size),
            }
        )

    manifest_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    manifest_path = bundle_dir / SUBMISSION_ASSET_MANIFEST_FILENAME
    manifest_df.to_csv(manifest_path, index=False)

    missing_optional_df = pd.DataFrame(
        missing_optional_rows,
        columns=["source_filename", "producer_stage", "expected_results_dir", "reason"],
    )
    missing_optional_path = ANALYSIS_QA_DIR / SUBMISSION_OPTIONAL_MISSING_FILENAME
    if missing_optional_df.empty:
        quiet_unlink(missing_optional_path, verbose=VERBOSE_RENDER)
        analysis_export_registry.pop("submission_asset_optional_missing", None)
        missing_optional_path_or_none: Path | None = None
    else:
        ANALYSIS_QA_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        missing_optional_df.to_csv(missing_optional_path, index=False)
        missing_optional_path_or_none = missing_optional_path

    validate_submission_asset_bundle(bundle_dir, manifest_df, missing_optional_df)

    register_export(
        key="submission_assets_dir",
        output_path=bundle_dir,
        builder="build_submission_asset_bundle",
        artifact_kind="directory",
        scope="submission",
        formats=["directory"],
    )
    register_export(
        key="submission_asset_manifest",
        output_path=manifest_path,
        builder="build_submission_asset_bundle",
        artifact_kind="manifest",
        scope="submission",
        formats=["csv"],
    )
    if missing_optional_path_or_none is not None:
        register_export(
            key="submission_asset_optional_missing",
            output_path=missing_optional_path_or_none,
            builder="build_submission_asset_bundle",
            artifact_kind="qa",
            scope="qa",
            formats=["csv"],
        )
    return bundle_dir, manifest_path, manifest_df, missing_optional_path_or_none, missing_optional_df


def build_submission_manifest(
    submission_asset_manifest: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    figure_denominator_map: dict[str, int],
    output_dir: Path,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Create the run-level manuscript artifact manifest requested for submission QA."""

    label_to_denominator = {
        "Figure 1": "broad EHR hypercapnia cohort",
        "Figure 2": "broad EHR hypercapnia cohort; overlapping ABG/VBG/ICD indicators",
        "Figure 3": "broad EHR hypercapnia cohort",
        "Figure 4": "blood-gas subset with paired qualifying-gas pH available",
        "Figure S1": "blood-gas subset with sufficient pH timing data",
        "Figure S2": "first-priority RFV sensitivity; overlapping ascertainment indicators",
        "Figure S3": "first-priority RFV sensitivity; age strata",
        "Figure S4": "first-priority RFV sensitivity; acidemia severity",
        "Figure S5": "first-priority RFV sensitivity; acidemia timing",
        "Figure S6": "broad EHR hypercapnia cohort; source-specific overlap",
        "Figure S7": "blood-gas subset with valid 0-24h timing",
        "Figure S8": "blood-gas subset with PCO2 bin and ICD status",
        "Figure S9": "blood-gas subset with QC-passing first_hco3",
        "Table 1": "broad EHR hypercapnia cohort and mutually exclusive ascertainment strata",
        "Table 2": "broad EHR hypercapnia cohort",
        "Supplementary Table S1": "broad EHR hypercapnia cohort",
    }
    label_to_rfv_definition = {
        "Table 2": "multi-label canonical RFV prevalence",
        "Supplementary Table S1": "raw triage chief complaint entries",
    }
    default_rfv_definition = "multi-label grouped RFV prevalence unless noted"
    first_priority_labels = {"Figure S2", "Figure S3", "Figure S4", "Figure S5"}
    rows = []
    for row in submission_asset_manifest.itertuples(index=False):
        manuscript_label = str(row.manuscript_label)
        figure_key = SUBMISSION_LABEL_TO_FIGURE_KEY.get(manuscript_label)
        if manuscript_label in first_priority_labels:
            rfv_definition = "first-priority grouped RFV sensitivity"
        else:
            rfv_definition = label_to_rfv_definition.get(manuscript_label, default_rfv_definition)
        rows.append(
            {
                "artifact_id": manuscript_label,
                "artifact_title": str(row.title),
                "source_script": str(row.source_notebook),
                "source_data": str(row.source_data_file),
                "cohort_denominator": label_to_denominator.get(manuscript_label, "see source workbook"),
                "cohort_denominator_n": int(figure_denominator_map.get(figure_key, 0)) if figure_key else pd.NA,
                "rfv_definition": rfv_definition,
                "gas_definition": "ICD-positive OR qualifying gas; ABG >=45, VBG >=50, UNKNOWN-source gas >=50 unless sensitivity-specific",
                "pH_definition": "paired qualifying-gas pH for Figure 4 where available; source workbook reports missingness",
                "hco3_definition": "first_hco3 with source/QC provenance for bicarbonate outputs; same-specimen HCO3 not yet claimed",
                "date_generated": RESULTS_DATE,
                "final_file_path": f"{SUBMISSION_ASSET_DIRNAME}/{row.file_name}",
                "caption_matches": False,
                "caption_check_status": "pending_manual_check",
                "include_in_submission": str(row.include_in_submission),
            }
        )
    manifest = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if manifest["artifact_id"].isna().any() or manifest["artifact_title"].astype("string").str.strip().eq("").any():
        raise ValueError("Submission manifest contains blank artifact identifiers or titles.")
    forbidden_columns = {"subject_id", "hadm_id", "ed_stay_id", "ed_triage_cc", "chief_complaint", "chiefcomplaint"}
    if forbidden_columns.intersection(manifest.columns):
        raise AssertionError(f"Submission manifest includes restricted row-level columns: {forbidden_columns}")
    missing_files = [
        final_path
        for final_path in manifest["final_file_path"].astype(str)
        if not (output_dir / final_path).exists()
    ]
    if missing_files:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Submission manifest points to missing files: {missing_files}")
    return manifest


def write_outputs_readme(
    output_dir: Path,
    submission_manifest: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    filename: str = "OUTPUTS_README.md",
) -> Path:
    """Write a run-specific README for collaborator/submission output review."""

    lines = [
        "# Hypercap CC NLP Output README",
        "",
        f"Generated date: `{RESULTS_DATE}`",
        "",
        "## Cohort Definitions",
        "- Primary cohort: ED-linked hospital admissions with nonmissing triage chief complaint and EHR evidence of hypercapnia by ICD code and/or qualifying gas.",
        "- Unit of analysis: hospital admission linked to an ED encounter.",
        "- Ascertainment indicators: ABG-positive, VBG-positive, and ICD-positive are overlapping.",
        "- Ascertainment strata: Gas-only, ICD-only, and Both ICD + gas are mutually exclusive.",
        "",
        "## RFV Framework",
        "- Primary RFV summaries use the current NHAMCS/RFV multi-label taxonomy.",
        "- First-priority RFV outputs are explicitly labeled as sensitivity analyses.",
        "- No new chief-concern categories, composites, or subcategories were added.",
        "",
        "## Gas, Timing, And Acid-Base Rules",
        "- Broad gas evidence uses qualifying pCO2 after the ED anchor through discharge.",
        "- Early timing windows are <=6h and <=24h from the ED anchor.",
        "- Figure 4 uses paired qualifying-gas pH when available and reports denominator/missingness in the source workbook.",
        "- Bicarbonate outputs use first_hco3 with source/QC provenance; same-specimen HCO3 requires a future cohort-stage rerun before manuscript claims.",
        "",
        "## Sensitivity Analyses Generated",
        "- First-admission sensitivity.",
        "- Timing-safeguard RFV comparison.",
        "- Gas-source, ICD-era, administrative-only exclusion, and stricter PCO2 threshold sensitivity suite.",
        "- First-priority RFV sensitivity figures.",
        "",
        "## Manifest",
        "- `submission_manifest.xlsx` and `submission_manifest.csv` map each manuscript-facing artifact to source, denominator, RFV definition, gas rule, pH/HCO3 rule, and caption-check status.",
        "- `submission_assets/submission_assets_manifest.csv` lists the clean copied submission bundle.",
        "",
        "## Included Submission Assets",
        "| Artifact | File | Denominator | Caption Check |",
        "|---|---|---|---|",
    ]
    for row in submission_manifest.itertuples(index=False):
        lines.append(
            f"| {row.artifact_id} | `{row.final_file_path}` | {row.cohort_denominator} | {row.caption_check_status} |"
        )
    lines.extend(
        [
            "",
            "## Known Limitations",
            "- These outputs describe admission-level EHR evidence patterns and do not adjudicate causal attribution.",
            "- Blood-gas testing, diagnosis coding, admission, and nonmissing triage text are clinical documentation/utilization processes.",
            "- Generated private row-level audits, if present, remain ignored and must not be committed.",
        ]
    )
    readme_path = output_dir / filename
    readme_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
    register_export(
        key="outputs_readme",
        output_path=readme_path,
        builder="write_outputs_readme",
        artifact_kind="documentation",
        scope="secondary",
        formats=["md"],
    )
    return readme_path


def classify_compensation(ph: float) -> str | float:
    """Map minimum 24h pH to the manuscript compensation groups."""

    if pd.isna(ph):
        return np.nan
    if ph >= 7.35:
        return "Compensated"
    if ph >= 7.30:
        return "Mild acidemia"
    if ph >= 7.25:
        return "Moderate acidemia"
    return "Severe acidemia"


def classify_acuity_group(value: object) -> str | float:
    """Collapse ESI triage values to high/moderate/low acuity."""

    acuity = pd.to_numeric(pd.Series([value]), errors="coerce").iloc[0]
    if pd.isna(acuity):
        return np.nan
    if acuity in {1, 2}:
        return "High acuity"
    if acuity == 3:
        return "Moderate acuity"
    return "Low acuity"


def derive_etiology_group(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Apply the manuscript etiology hierarchy used in the former Reyan workflow."""

    opioid = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_opioid_substance"]))
    neuro = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_neuromuscular"]))
    ohs = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_osa_ohs"]))
    copd = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_copd"]))
    chf = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_chf"]))
    pneumonia = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["flag_pneumonia"]))

    labels = np.select(
        [
            opioid.eq(1),
            neuro.eq(1),
            ohs.eq(1),
            copd.eq(1),
            chf.eq(1),
            pneumonia.eq(1),
        ],
        [
            "Opioid",
            "Neuromuscular",
            "OHS",
            "COPD",
            "CHF",
            "Infection (Pneumonia)",
        ],
        default="Other/Unclassified",
    )
    return pd.Series(labels, index=df.index, name="etiology_group")


def derive_qualifying_site(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Approximate the qualifying gas site using the canonical workbook columns."""

    specimen = maybe_series(df, ["first_gas_specimen_type"]).astype("string").str.upper()
    site = pd.Series("UNKNOWN", index=df.index, dtype="string")
    site = site.mask(specimen.str.contains("ART", na=False), "ABG")
    site = site.mask(specimen.str.contains("VEN", na=False), "VBG")

    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN") & maybe_numeric(df, ["first_pco2"]).eq(maybe_numeric(df, ["first_abg_pco2"])),
        "ABG",
    )
    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN") & maybe_numeric(df, ["first_pco2"]).eq(maybe_numeric(df, ["first_vbg_pco2"])),
        "VBG",
    )
    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN") & maybe_numeric(df, ["first_other_pco2"]).notna(),
        "UNKNOWN",
    )
    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN")
        & to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["abg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)
        & to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["vbg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(0),
        "ABG",
    )
    site = site.mask(
        site.eq("UNKNOWN")
        & to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["vbg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)
        & to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["abg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(0),
        "VBG",
    )
    return site.rename("qualifying_site_group")


def select_analysis_ph_with_source(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Select pH under the current Figure 4 source-priority rule and audit source."""

    lab_abg_ph = maybe_numeric(df, ["lab_abg_ph"])
    lab_vbg_ph = maybe_numeric(df, ["lab_vbg_ph"])
    first_panel_ph = maybe_numeric(df, ["first_ph", "min_ph_0_24h"])

    lab_ph = lab_abg_ph.copy()
    source = pd.Series("missing", index=df.index, dtype="string")
    source = source.mask(lab_abg_ph.notna(), "lab_abg_ph")

    fill_from_vbg = lab_ph.isna() & lab_vbg_ph.notna()
    lab_ph = lab_ph.where(~fill_from_vbg, lab_vbg_ph)
    source = source.mask(fill_from_vbg, "lab_vbg_ph")

    fill_from_first_panel = lab_ph.isna() & first_panel_ph.notna()
    lab_ph = lab_ph.where(~fill_from_first_panel, first_panel_ph)
    source = source.mask(fill_from_first_panel, "first_ph_or_min_ph_0_24h")

    return pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "analysis_ph": lab_ph.rename("analysis_ph"),
            "analysis_ph_source": source.rename("analysis_ph_source"),
        },
        index=df.index,
    )


def select_analysis_ph(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Select pH using the same source-priority rule as the current Figure 4 analysis."""

    return select_analysis_ph_with_source(df)["analysis_ph"].rename("analysis_ph")


def select_paired_qualifying_ph_for_figure4(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Return paired qualifying-gas pH, failing closed if the cohort export lacks it."""

    if "qualifying_ph" not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(
            "Figure 4 was configured for paired qualifying-gas pH, but qualifying_ph is absent from the cohort handoff."
        )
    return pd.to_numeric(df["qualifying_ph"], errors="coerce").rename("analysis_ph")


def select_figure4_analysis_ph(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Select pH according to the active Figure 4 acidemia rule."""

    if FIGURE4_USE_PAIRED_QUALIFYING_PH:
        return select_paired_qualifying_ph_for_figure4(df)
    return select_analysis_ph(df)


def build_acidemia_ph_source_audit(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Summarize the active Figure 4 pH source rule without exporting row-level fields."""

    denominator = len(df)
    if FIGURE4_USE_PAIRED_QUALIFYING_PH:
        rows = []
        for audit_group, series in (
            (
                "qualifying_ph_pairing_status",
                maybe_series(df, ["qualifying_ph_pairing_status"]).astype("string").fillna("missing_pairing_status"),
            ),
            (
                "qualifying_ph_source_branch",
                maybe_series(df, ["qualifying_ph_source_branch"]).astype("string").fillna("missing_source_branch"),
            ),
            (
                "qualifying_ph_site",
                maybe_series(df, ["qualifying_ph_site"]).astype("string").fillna("missing_site"),
            ),
        ):
            counts = series.value_counts(dropna=False).sort_index()
            for category, n_admissions in counts.items():
                rows.append(
                    {
                        "audit_group": audit_group,
                        "category": category,
                        "n_admissions": int(n_admissions),
                        "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                            round(int(n_admissions) / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan
                        ),
                    }
                )
        return pd.DataFrame(rows)

    ph_selection = select_analysis_ph_with_source(df)
    source_order = ["lab_abg_ph", "lab_vbg_ph", "first_ph_or_min_ph_0_24h", "missing"]
    source_labels = {
        "lab_abg_ph": "Laboratory arterial pH",
        "lab_vbg_ph": "Laboratory venous pH",
        "first_ph_or_min_ph_0_24h": "First PCO2-containing panel pH or minimum pH within 24h",
        "missing": "No pH available under source-priority rule",
    }
    counts = ph_selection["analysis_ph_source"].value_counts(dropna=False).reindex(source_order, fill_value=0)
    rows = []
    for order, source_key in enumerate(source_order, start=1):
        n_admissions = int(counts.loc[source_key])
        rows.append(
            {
                "source_rule_order": order,
                "analysis_ph_source": source_key,
                "source_label": source_labels[source_key],
                "n_admissions": n_admissions,
                "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                    round(n_admissions / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan
                ),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_acidemia_severity_denominator_audit(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Aggregate denominator and missingness audit for Figure 4 acidemia severity."""

    figure4_ph = select_figure4_analysis_ph(df)
    figure4_ph_available = figure4_ph.notna()
    ph_selection = select_analysis_ph_with_source(df)
    source_priority_available = ph_selection["analysis_ph"].notna()
    denominator = len(df)
    paired_field_present = "qualifying_ph" in df.columns
    if paired_field_present:
        paired_ph = pd.to_numeric(df["qualifying_ph"], errors="coerce")
        paired_available_n = int(paired_ph.notna().sum())
        paired_missing_n = int(denominator - paired_available_n)
        paired_note = "pH from the same specimen/panel as the earliest qualifying PCO2, when available."
    else:
        paired_available_n = pd.NA
        paired_missing_n = pd.NA
        paired_note = "qualifying_ph absent; keep Figure 4 source-priority pH until paired-pH audit is available."

    active_rule = "paired qualifying-gas pH" if FIGURE4_USE_PAIRED_QUALIFYING_PH else "source-priority pH"

    rows = [
        {
            "audit_item": "blood_gas_subset_denominator",
            "n_admissions": int(denominator),
            "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": 100.0 if denominator else np.nan,
            "reason": "Admissions with qualifying PCO2 before pH restriction",
        },
        {
            "audit_item": "included_active_figure4_ph_available",
            "n_admissions": int(figure4_ph_available.sum()),
            "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                round(figure4_ph_available.sum() / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan
            ),
            "reason": f"Included in current Figure 4 {active_rule} analysis",
        },
        {
            "audit_item": "excluded_active_figure4_ph_missing",
            "n_admissions": int((~figure4_ph_available).sum()),
            "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                round((~figure4_ph_available).sum() / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan
            ),
            "reason": f"Missing pH under current Figure 4 {active_rule} analysis",
        },
        {
            "audit_item": "included_source_priority_ph_available",
            "n_admissions": int(source_priority_available.sum()),
            "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                round(source_priority_available.sum() / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan
            ),
            "reason": "Included in current Figure 4 source-priority pH analysis",
        },
        {
            "audit_item": "excluded_source_priority_ph_missing",
            "n_admissions": int((~source_priority_available).sum()),
            "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                round((~source_priority_available).sum() / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan
            ),
            "reason": "No pH available under source-priority rule",
        },
        {
            "audit_item": "paired_qualifying_ph_available",
            "n_admissions": paired_available_n,
            "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                round(paired_available_n / denominator * 100, 2)
                if denominator and paired_field_present
                else pd.NA
            ),
            "reason": paired_note,
        },
        {
            "audit_item": "paired_qualifying_ph_missing",
            "n_admissions": paired_missing_n,
            "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                round(paired_missing_n / denominator * 100, 2)
                if denominator and paired_field_present
                else pd.NA
            ),
            "reason": paired_note,
        },
    ]
    if "qualifying_ph_pairing_status" in df.columns:
        status_counts = (
            df["qualifying_ph_pairing_status"]
            .astype("string")
            .fillna("missing_pairing_status")
            .value_counts()
            .sort_index()
        )
        for status, n_admissions in status_counts.items():
            rows.append(
                {
                    "audit_item": f"pairing_status_{status}",
                    "n_admissions": int(n_admissions),
                    "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                        round(int(n_admissions) / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan
                    ),
                    "reason": "Cohort-stage qualifying pH pairing status",
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_acidemia_timing_denominator_audit(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Aggregate denominator and missingness audit for acidemia timing summaries."""

    min_6h = maybe_numeric(df, ["min_ph_0_6h"])
    min_24h = maybe_numeric(df, ["min_ph_0_24h"])
    timing_group = classify_timing_group(df)
    included = timing_group.notna()

    reason = pd.Series("included_timing_classifiable", index=df.index, dtype="string")
    reason = reason.mask(~included & min_24h.isna(), "excluded_no_ph_within_24h")
    reason = reason.mask(
        ~included & min_24h.lt(7.35) & min_6h.isna(),
        "excluded_acidemia_within_24h_missing_0_6h_ph",
    )
    reason = reason.mask(~included & reason.eq("included_timing_classifiable"), "excluded_unclassified_timing")

    reason_order = [
        "included_timing_classifiable",
        "excluded_no_ph_within_24h",
        "excluded_acidemia_within_24h_missing_0_6h_ph",
        "excluded_unclassified_timing",
    ]
    labels = {
        "included_timing_classifiable": "Included: sufficient pH timing data for early/late/no-acidemia assignment",
        "excluded_no_ph_within_24h": "Excluded: no pH available within 24h window",
        "excluded_acidemia_within_24h_missing_0_6h_ph": "Excluded: acidemia within 24h but no pH in 0-6h window",
        "excluded_unclassified_timing": "Excluded: pH timing did not satisfy prespecified timing rules",
    }
    denominator = len(df)
    counts = reason.value_counts(dropna=False).reindex(reason_order, fill_value=0)
    rows = []
    for reason_key in reason_order:
        n_admissions = int(counts.loc[reason_key])
        rows.append(
            {
                "audit_item": reason_key,
                "n_admissions": n_admissions,
                "percent_of_blood_gas_subset": (
                    round(n_admissions / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan
                ),
                "reason": labels[reason_key],
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def first_hco3_qc_pass_mask(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Return rows with available first_hco3 values that pass optional QC flags."""

    hco3_values = maybe_numeric(df, ["first_hco3"])
    if "first_hco3_qc_flag" in df.columns:
        first_hco3_qc_raw = df["first_hco3_qc_flag"]
        first_hco3_qc_pass = (
            pd.to_numeric(first_hco3_qc_raw, errors="coerce").fillna(0).gt(0)
            | first_hco3_qc_raw.astype("string").str.lower().isin(["true", "t", "yes"])
        )
    else:
        first_hco3_qc_pass = pd.Series(True, index=df.index)
    return (hco3_values.notna() & first_hco3_qc_pass).rename("first_hco3_qc_pass")


def derive_ph_severity(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Recreate the descriptive acidemia severity labels used for Figure 4."""

    lab_ph = select_figure4_analysis_ph(df)

    severity = np.select(
        [
            lab_ph.ge(7.35),
            lab_ph.between(7.30, 7.34, inclusive="both"),
            lab_ph.between(7.25, 7.29, inclusive="both"),
            lab_ph.lt(7.25),
        ],
        [
            "Normal/compensated (pH ≥7.35)",
            "Mild (7.30–7.34)",
            "Moderate (7.25–7.29)",
            "Severe (pH <7.25)",
        ],
        default=None,
    )
    return pd.Series(severity, index=df.index, name="ph_severity")


def classify_timing_group(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Recreate the early/late/no acidemia grouping used for the manuscript timing figure."""

    min_6h = maybe_numeric(df, ["min_ph_0_6h"])
    min_24h = maybe_numeric(df, ["min_ph_0_24h"])

    labels = np.select(
        [
            min_6h.lt(7.35),
            min_6h.ge(7.35) & min_24h.lt(7.35),
            min_24h.ge(7.35),
        ],
        ["Early acidemia", "Late acidemia", "No acidemia"],
        default=None,
    )
    return pd.Series(labels, index=df.index, name="timing_group")


def assign_frozen_ph_band(ph_values: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Assign the frozen submission pH bands used for acid-base supplement outputs."""

    ph = pd.to_numeric(ph_values, errors="coerce")
    labels = np.select(
        [
            ph.lt(7.20),
            ph.ge(7.20) & ph.lt(7.25),
            ph.ge(7.25) & ph.lt(7.30),
            ph.ge(7.30) & ph.lt(7.35),
            ph.ge(7.35) & ph.lt(7.45),
            ph.ge(7.45),
        ],
        FROZEN_PH_BAND_ORDER,
        default=None,
    )
    return pd.Series(
        pd.Categorical(labels, categories=FROZEN_PH_BAND_ORDER, ordered=True),
        index=ph_values.index,
        name="frozen_ph_band",
    )


def assign_frozen_hco3_band(hco3_values: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Assign the frozen submission bicarbonate bands used for acid-base outputs."""

    hco3 = pd.to_numeric(hco3_values, errors="coerce")
    labels = np.select(
        [
            hco3.lt(22),
            hco3.ge(22) & hco3.lt(28),
            hco3.ge(28) & hco3.lt(34),
            hco3.ge(34),
        ],
        FROZEN_HCO3_BAND_ORDER,
        default=None,
    )
    return pd.Series(
        pd.Categorical(labels, categories=FROZEN_HCO3_BAND_ORDER, ordered=True),
        index=hco3_values.index,
        name="frozen_hco3_band",
    )


def derive_acid_base_state(ph_values: pd.Series, hco3_values: pd.Series) -> pd.Series:
    """Classify descriptive acid-base state without implying chronicity or causality."""

    ph = pd.to_numeric(ph_values, errors="coerce")
    hco3 = pd.to_numeric(hco3_values, errors="coerce")
    missing = ph.isna() | hco3.isna()
    labels = np.select(
        [
            missing,
            ph.lt(7.35) & hco3.lt(22),
            ph.lt(7.35) & hco3.ge(22) & hco3.lt(28),
            ph.lt(7.35) & hco3.ge(28),
            ph.ge(7.35) & ph.lt(7.45) & hco3.ge(28),
            ph.ge(7.45) & hco3.ge(28),
            ph.ge(7.35) & hco3.lt(28),
        ],
        [
            "indeterminate",
            "acidemic with low HCO3",
            "acidemic with reference HCO3",
            "acidemic with elevated HCO3",
            "non-acidemic with elevated HCO3",
            "alkalemic with elevated HCO3",
            "non-acidemic without elevated HCO3",
        ],
        default="indeterminate",
    )
    return pd.Series(
        pd.Categorical(labels, categories=ACID_BASE_STATE_ORDER, ordered=True),
        index=ph_values.index,
        name="acid_base_state",
    )


def build_acid_base_source_missingness_table(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Create aggregate acid-base availability/source rows without identifiers."""

    denominator = int(len(df))
    pco2_available = maybe_numeric(df, ["qualifying_pco2_mmhg"]).notna()
    ph_available = select_figure4_analysis_ph(df).notna()
    hco3_available = first_hco3_qc_pass_mask(df)
    first_gas_hours = maybe_numeric(df, ["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours", "time_to_gas_hrs"])
    source_flags = {
        "Pco2 source: ABG": to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["abg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1),
        "Pco2 source: VBG": to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["vbg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1),
        "Pco2 source: UNKNOWN-source gas": to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["unknown_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1),
    }
    rows = [
        ("Any qualifying PCO2", pco2_available, "qualifying_pco2_mmhg available"),
        ("pH available", ph_available, "active Figure 4 pH rule"),
        ("HCO3 available", hco3_available, "first_hco3 available and QC-passing"),
        ("pH + HCO3 both available", ph_available & hco3_available, "active pH plus QC-passing first_hco3"),
        ("First qualifying gas time available", first_gas_hours.notna(), "dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours available"),
        ("First qualifying gas within 6h", first_gas_hours.lt(6), "first qualifying gas <6h from ED anchor"),
        ("First qualifying gas within 24h", first_gas_hours.le(24), "first qualifying gas <=24h from ED anchor"),
    ]
    rows.extend((label, mask, label) for label, mask in source_flags.items())
    out = []
    for label, mask, definition in rows:
        n_admissions = int(mask.fillna(False).sum())
        out.append(
            {
                "measure": label,
                "n_admissions": n_admissions,
                "denominator": denominator,
                "percent_of_denominator": round(n_admissions / denominator * 100, 2) if denominator else np.nan,
                "definition": definition,
                "row_level_identifiers_exported": False,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(out)


def build_candidate_definition_membership(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Build candidate phenotype-enrichment definition flags using current fields only."""

    any_icd = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["any_hypercap_icd"])).eq(1)
    any_gas = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["pco2_threshold_any"])).eq(1)
    gas_hours = maybe_numeric(df, ["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours", "time_to_gas_hrs"])
    ph = select_figure4_analysis_ph(df)
    hco3_available = first_hco3_qc_pass_mask(df)
    hco3 = maybe_numeric(df, ["first_hco3"])
    time_to_imv = maybe_numeric(df, ["time_to_imv_hrs", "dt_first_imv_hours", "dt_first_imv_hours_model"])
    time_to_niv = maybe_numeric(df, ["time_to_niv_hrs", "dt_first_niv_hours", "dt_first_niv_hours_model"])
    gas_time_missing_or_not_applicable = (~any_gas) | gas_hours.isna()
    gas_precedes_imv = gas_time_missing_or_not_applicable | time_to_imv.isna() | gas_hours.lt(time_to_imv)
    gas_precedes_niv = gas_time_missing_or_not_applicable | time_to_niv.isna() | gas_hours.lt(time_to_niv)
    post_vent_only = any_gas & (
        (time_to_imv.notna() & gas_hours.ge(time_to_imv))
        | (time_to_niv.notna() & gas_hours.ge(time_to_niv))
    )
    membership = pd.DataFrame(index=df.index)
    membership["Broad EHR hypercapnia cohort"] = any_icd | any_gas
    membership["Any qualifying gas"] = any_gas
    membership["Gas-only"] = any_gas & (~any_icd)
    membership["ICD-only"] = any_icd & (~any_gas)
    membership["Both ICD + gas"] = any_icd & any_gas
    membership["Early gas <=24h"] = any_gas & gas_hours.le(24)
    membership["Early gas <=6h"] = any_gas & gas_hours.lt(6)
    membership["Early acidemic gas <=24h"] = any_gas & gas_hours.le(24) & ph.lt(7.35)
    membership["Early acidemic gas <=6h"] = any_gas & gas_hours.lt(6) & ph.lt(7.35)
    membership["Early gas + elevated HCO3"] = any_gas & gas_hours.le(24) & hco3_available & hco3.ge(28)
    membership["ICD + early gas"] = any_icd & any_gas & gas_hours.le(24)
    membership["ICD + early acidemic gas"] = any_icd & any_gas & gas_hours.le(24) & ph.lt(7.35)
    membership["Exclude post-ventilation-only gas"] = (any_icd | any_gas) & (~post_vent_only) & gas_precedes_imv & gas_precedes_niv
    return membership.astype(bool)


def summarize_candidate_definition_yield(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    membership: pd.DataFrame,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Summarize yield and physiologic/context composition for candidate definitions."""

    broad_n = int(membership.iloc[:, 0].sum()) if not membership.empty else 0
    ph = select_figure4_analysis_ph(df)
    hco3 = maybe_numeric(df, ["first_hco3"])
    hco3_available = first_hco3_qc_pass_mask(df)
    respiratory = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["has_group_respiratory"])).eq(1)
    nervous = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["has_group_nervous"])).eq(1)
    injury = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["has_group_injuries_adverse_effects"])).eq(1)
    administrative = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["has_rfv_administrative", "has_group_administrative"])).eq(1)
    any_icd = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["any_hypercap_icd"])).eq(1)
    imv = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["imv_flag"])).eq(1)
    niv = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["niv_flag"])).eq(1)
    vent_24h = (
        maybe_numeric(df, ["time_to_imv_hrs", "dt_first_imv_hours", "dt_first_imv_hours_model"]).le(24)
        | maybe_numeric(df, ["time_to_niv_hrs", "dt_first_niv_hours", "dt_first_niv_hours_model"]).le(24)
    )
    mortality = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["death_in_hosp"])).eq(1)
    los = maybe_numeric(df, ["hosp_los_days"])
    pco2 = maybe_numeric(df, ["qualifying_pco2_mmhg"])

    def _pct(mask: pd.Series, subset: pd.Series) -> float:
        denominator = int(subset.sum())
        if denominator == 0:
            return np.nan
        return round(int((mask & subset).sum()) / denominator * 100, 2)

    rows = []
    for order, definition_name in enumerate(membership.columns, start=1):
        subset = membership[definition_name].fillna(False)
        n_retained = int(subset.sum())
        rows.append(
            {
                "definition_order": order,
                "candidate_definition": definition_name,
                "N_retained": n_retained,
                "percent_of_broad_cohort_retained": round(n_retained / broad_n * 100, 2) if broad_n else np.nan,
                "percent_respiratory_rfv": _pct(respiratory, subset),
                "percent_nervous_rfv": _pct(nervous, subset),
                "percent_injuries_adverse_effects_rfv": _pct(injury, subset),
                "percent_administrative_rfv": _pct(administrative, subset),
                "median_qualifying_pco2": round(float(pco2.loc[subset].median()), 1) if pco2.loc[subset].notna().any() else np.nan,
                "percent_ph_lt_7_35": _pct(ph.lt(7.35), subset),
                "percent_ph_lt_7_25": _pct(ph.lt(7.25), subset),
                "percent_ph_ge_7_45": _pct(ph.ge(7.45), subset),
                "percent_hco3_ge_28": _pct(hco3_available & hco3.ge(28), subset),
                "percent_hco3_ge_34": _pct(hco3_available & hco3.ge(34), subset),
                "percent_icd_positive": _pct(any_icd, subset),
                "percent_niv_or_imv_24h": _pct(vent_24h, subset),
                "percent_any_imv_or_niv": _pct(imv | niv, subset),
                "in_hospital_mortality_percent": _pct(mortality, subset),
                "median_hospital_los_days": round(float(los.loc[subset].median()), 1) if los.loc[subset].notna().any() else np.nan,
                "interpretation_note": "Candidate enrichment rule only; not causal adjudication.",
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def summarize_rfv_by_candidate_definition(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    membership: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    grouped: bool = True,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Summarize RFV composition for each candidate definition."""

    pieces = []
    for order, definition_name in enumerate(membership.columns, start=1):
        subset_df = df.loc[membership[definition_name]].copy()
        if subset_df.empty:
            continue
        subset_df["candidate_definition"] = definition_name
        summary = summarize_multilabel_prevalence(
            subset_df,
            strata="candidate_definition",
            grouped=grouped,
        )
        summary.insert(0, "definition_order", order)
        pieces.append(summary)
    if not pieces:
        return pd.DataFrame()
    return pd.concat(pieces, ignore_index=True)


def build_gas_source_sensitivity_summary(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Compare broad/gas-source sensitivity denominators and grouped RFV composition."""

    unknown = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["unknown_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)
    any_gas = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["pco2_threshold_any"])).eq(1)
    frames = {
        "Broad EHR cohort": df,
        "Any qualifying gas": df.loc[any_gas],
        "Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence": df.loc[~unknown],
        "Gas-positive excluding UNKNOWN-source gas": df.loc[any_gas & ~unknown],
        "ABG-positive": df.loc[to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["abg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)],
        "VBG-positive": df.loc[to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["vbg_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)],
    }
    rows = []
    for label, frame in frames.items():
        rows.append(
            {
                "sensitivity": label,
                "N_admissions": int(len(frame)),
                "percent_of_broad_cohort": round(len(frame) / max(len(df), 1) * 100, 2),
                "unknown_source_gas_n": int(to_binary_flag(maybe_series(frame, ["unknown_hypercap_threshold"])).sum()) if len(frame) else 0,
                "respiratory_rfv_percent": (
                    round(to_binary_flag(maybe_series(frame, ["has_group_respiratory"])).mean() * 100, 2)
                    if len(frame)
                    else np.nan
                ),
                "administrative_rfv_percent": (
                    round(to_binary_flag(maybe_series(frame, ["has_rfv_administrative", "has_group_administrative"])).mean() * 100, 2)
                    if len(frame)
                    else np.nan
                ),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_icd_era_sensitivity_summary(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Summarize ICD-positive yield by admission year and inferred ICD era."""

    admit_time = maybe_datetime(df, ["admittime", "ed_anchor_time", "ed_intime"])
    admit_year = admit_time.dt.year
    icd_positive = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["any_hypercap_icd"])).eq(1)
    era = pd.Series("missing_admission_year", index=df.index, dtype="string")
    era = era.mask(admit_year.lt(2015), "pre_ICD10")
    era = era.mask(admit_year.ge(2015), "ICD10_era")
    summary = (
        pd.DataFrame({"admission_year": admit_year, "icd_era": era, "icd_positive": icd_positive.astype(int)})
        .groupby(["icd_era", "admission_year"], dropna=False)
        .agg(N_admissions=("icd_positive", "size"), n_icd_positive=("icd_positive", "sum"))
        .reset_index()
    )
    summary["percent_icd_positive"] = (
        summary["n_icd_positive"] / summary["N_admissions"].replace(0, np.nan) * 100
    ).round(2)
    return summary


def _administrative_only_rfv_mask(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    """Return True for rows with Administrative RFV and no other RFV indicator."""

    administrative = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["has_rfv_administrative", "has_group_administrative"])).eq(1)
    indicator_cols = [
        column
        for column in df.columns
        if column.startswith("has_rfv_") or column.startswith("has_group_")
    ]
    non_admin_cols = [
        column
        for column in indicator_cols
        if column not in {"has_rfv_administrative", "has_group_administrative"}
    ]
    non_admin_any = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    for column in non_admin_cols:
        non_admin_any = non_admin_any | to_binary_flag(df[column]).eq(1)
    return administrative & (~non_admin_any)


def build_administrative_exclusion_sensitivity(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Summarize impact of excluding administrative-only RFV presentations."""

    admin_only = _administrative_only_rfv_mask(df)
    frames = {
        "Primary cohort": df,
        "Exclude administrative-only RFV": df.loc[~admin_only],
    }
    rows = []
    grouped_categories = [
        category
        for category in ordered_rfv_display_categories(RFV_GROUP_ORDER)
        if f"has_group_{_slugify_category(category)}" in df.columns
    ]
    for label, frame in frames.items():
        for category in grouped_categories:
            flag_column = f"has_group_{_slugify_category(category)}"
            flag = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(frame, [flag_column])).eq(1)
            n_with_category = int(flag.sum()) if len(frame) else 0
            rows.append(
                {
                    "sensitivity": label,
                    "grouped_rfv_category": category,
                    "N_admissions": int(len(frame)),
                    "excluded_administrative_only_n": int(admin_only.sum()) if label != "Primary cohort" else 0,
                    "n_with_category": n_with_category,
                    "percent_with_category": round(n_with_category / max(len(frame), 1) * 100, 2) if len(frame) else np.nan,
                }
            )
    out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if out.empty:
        return out
    primary_lookup = (
        out.loc[out["sensitivity"].eq("Primary cohort"), ["grouped_rfv_category", "percent_with_category"]]
        .set_index("grouped_rfv_category")["percent_with_category"]
    )
    out["difference_pp_vs_primary"] = out.apply(
        lambda row: round(
            float(row["percent_with_category"])
            - float(primary_lookup.get(row["grouped_rfv_category"], np.nan)),
            2,
        ),
        axis=1,
    )
    return out


def _any_numeric_candidate_ge(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    candidates: list[str],
    threshold: float,
) -> pd.Series:
    """Return True when any available numeric candidate column is at least threshold."""

    if np.isinf(threshold):
        return pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    mask = pd.Series(False, index=df.index)
    for column in candidates:
        if column in df.columns:
            mask = mask | pd.to_numeric(df[column], errors="coerce").ge(threshold).fillna(False)
    return mask


def source_specific_pco2_threshold_mask(
    df: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    abg_threshold: float,
    vbg_threshold: float,
    unknown_threshold: float,
) -> pd.Series:
    """Evaluate stricter PCO2 thresholds using source-specific gas evidence."""

    selected_source = maybe_series(df, ["qualifying_site_group"]).astype("string").fillna("UNKNOWN")
    selected_pco2 = maybe_numeric(df, ["qualifying_pco2_mmhg"])
    abg_pass = _any_numeric_candidate_ge(
        df,
        [
            "first_abg_hypercap_pco2_mmhg",
            "lab_abg_paco2",
            "poc_abg_paco2",
            "first_abg_pco2",
        ],
        abg_threshold,
    )
    vbg_pass = _any_numeric_candidate_ge(
        df,
        [
            "first_vbg_hypercap_pco2_mmhg",
            "lab_vbg_paco2",
            "poc_vbg_paco2",
            "first_vbg_pco2",
        ],
        vbg_threshold,
    )
    unknown_pass = _any_numeric_candidate_ge(
        df,
        [
            "first_other_hypercap_pco2_mmhg",
            "first_other_pco2",
        ],
        unknown_threshold,
    )
    abg_pass = abg_pass | (selected_source.eq("ABG") & selected_pco2.ge(abg_threshold).fillna(False))
    vbg_pass = vbg_pass | (selected_source.eq("VBG") & selected_pco2.ge(vbg_threshold).fillna(False))
    unknown_pass = unknown_pass | (
        selected_source.eq("UNKNOWN") & selected_pco2.ge(unknown_threshold).fillna(False)
    )
    return abg_pass | vbg_pass | unknown_pass


def build_pco2_threshold_sensitivity_summary(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Summarize stricter PCO2 threshold sensitivity among blood-gas-positive admissions."""

    any_gas = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["pco2_threshold_any"])).eq(1)
    unknown = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["unknown_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)
    gas_denominator_n = int(any_gas.sum())
    specs = [
        ("Primary thresholds", 45, 50, 50),
        ("ABG>=50 VBG>=55 UNKNOWN>=55", 50, 55, 55),
        ("ABG>=55 VBG>=60 UNKNOWN>=60", 55, 60, 60),
        ("Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence", 45, 50, np.inf),
    ]
    rows = []
    for label, abg_threshold, vbg_threshold, unknown_threshold in specs:
        if label == "Primary thresholds":
            gas_pass = any_gas
        elif label == "Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence":
            gas_pass = any_gas & (~unknown)
        else:
            gas_pass = source_specific_pco2_threshold_mask(
                df,
                abg_threshold=abg_threshold,
                vbg_threshold=vbg_threshold,
                unknown_threshold=unknown_threshold,
            )
        retained = any_gas & gas_pass
        rows.append(
            {
                "threshold_sensitivity": label,
                "denominator_scope": "Blood-gas-positive admissions",
                "abg_threshold_mmhg": abg_threshold,
                "vbg_threshold_mmhg": vbg_threshold,
                "unknown_threshold_mmhg": "excluded" if np.isinf(unknown_threshold) else unknown_threshold,
                "pco2_evidence_rule": (
                    "source-specific exported PCO2 evidence"
                    if label not in {"Primary thresholds", "Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence"}
                    else "primary gas flag or explicit UNKNOWN-source exclusion"
                ),
                "N_retained": int(retained.sum()),
                "N_denominator": gas_denominator_n,
                "percent_of_gas_positive_retained": round(retained.sum() / max(gas_denominator_n, 1) * 100, 2),
                "respiratory_rfv_percent": round(to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df.loc[retained], ["has_group_respiratory"])).mean() * 100, 2) if retained.any() else np.nan,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_analytic_cohort_threshold_sensitivity_summary(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Summarize threshold sensitivity for the ICD-or-gas analytic union."""

    any_icd = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["any_hypercap_icd"])).eq(1)
    any_gas = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["pco2_threshold_any"])).eq(1)
    unknown = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["unknown_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)
    specs = [
        ("Primary thresholds", 45, 50, 50),
        ("ABG>=50 VBG>=55 UNKNOWN>=55", 50, 55, 55),
        ("ABG>=55 VBG>=60 UNKNOWN>=60", 55, 60, 60),
        ("Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence", 45, 50, np.inf),
    ]
    rows = []
    for label, abg_threshold, vbg_threshold, unknown_threshold in specs:
        if label == "Primary thresholds":
            retained = any_icd | any_gas
        elif label == "Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence":
            retained = (any_icd | any_gas) & (~unknown)
        else:
            gas_pass = source_specific_pco2_threshold_mask(
                df,
                abg_threshold=abg_threshold,
                vbg_threshold=vbg_threshold,
                unknown_threshold=unknown_threshold,
            )
            retained = any_icd | gas_pass
        rows.append(
            {
                "threshold_sensitivity": label,
                "denominator_scope": "Analytic ICD-or-gas cohort",
                "abg_threshold_mmhg": abg_threshold,
                "vbg_threshold_mmhg": vbg_threshold,
                "unknown_threshold_mmhg": "excluded" if np.isinf(unknown_threshold) else unknown_threshold,
                "pco2_evidence_rule": (
                    "source-specific exported PCO2 evidence"
                    if label not in {"Primary thresholds", "Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence"}
                    else "primary ICD-or-gas flag or explicit UNKNOWN-source exclusion"
                ),
                "N_retained": int(retained.sum()),
                "N_denominator": int(len(df)),
                "percent_of_analytic_cohort_retained": round(retained.sum() / max(len(df), 1) * 100, 2),
                "respiratory_rfv_percent": round(to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df.loc[retained], ["has_group_respiratory"])).mean() * 100, 2) if retained.any() else np.nan,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def build_sensitivity_denominator_audit(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Return one canonical aggregate denominator table for sensitivity outputs."""

    ensure_required_columns(df, ["pco2_threshold_any", "any_hypercap_icd"])
    any_gas = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["pco2_threshold_any"])).eq(1)
    any_icd = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["any_hypercap_icd"])).eq(1)
    gas_hours = maybe_numeric(df, ["dt_qualifying_hypercapnia_hours", "time_to_gas_hrs"])
    unknown = to_binary_flag(maybe_series(df, ["unknown_hypercap_threshold"])).eq(1)
    first_admission = first_eligible_admission_mask(df)
    admin_only = _administrative_only_rfv_mask(df)
    broad = any_icd | any_gas
    masks = {
        "Broad EHR cohort": broad,
        "Blood-gas-positive": any_gas,
        "ICD-positive": any_icd,
        "Gas-only": any_gas & (~any_icd),
        "ICD-only": any_icd & (~any_gas),
        "Both ICD + gas": any_icd & any_gas,
        "UNKNOWN-source gas": unknown,
        "First qualifying gas <=24h": any_gas & gas_hours.le(24),
        "First qualifying gas <6h": any_gas & gas_hours.lt(6),
        "First admission per patient": first_admission,
        "Exclude administrative-only RFV": ~admin_only,
        "Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence": ~unknown,
        "Gas-positive excluding UNKNOWN-source gas": any_gas & (~unknown),
    }
    broad_denominator = int(broad.sum())
    return pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {
                "denominator_label": label,
                "N_admissions": int(mask.fillna(False).sum()),
                "percent_of_broad_cohort": round(int(mask.fillna(False).sum()) / max(broad_denominator, 1) * 100, 2),
                "definition": _sensitivity_denominator_definition(label),
                "row_level_identifiers_exported": False,
            }
            for label, mask in masks.items()
        ]
    )


def _sensitivity_denominator_definition(label: str) -> str:
    """Return a concise denominator definition for the sensitivity audit."""

    definitions = {
        "Broad EHR cohort": "Any ICD hypercapnia/OHS/RF code or qualifying PCO2 after ED anchor through discharge.",
        "Blood-gas-positive": "Any qualifying PCO2 after ED anchor through discharge.",
        "ICD-positive": "Any hypercapnia/OHS/RF ICD phenotype.",
        "Gas-only": "Qualifying PCO2 and no hypercapnia/OHS/RF ICD phenotype.",
        "ICD-only": "Hypercapnia/OHS/RF ICD phenotype and no qualifying PCO2.",
        "Both ICD + gas": "Both hypercapnia/OHS/RF ICD phenotype and qualifying PCO2.",
        "UNKNOWN-source gas": "Any qualifying gas classified as UNKNOWN/indeterminate source.",
        "First qualifying gas <=24h": "Qualifying PCO2 at or before 24h from ED anchor.",
        "First qualifying gas <6h": "Qualifying PCO2 before 6h from ED anchor.",
        "First admission per patient": "First eligible admission per subject_id by deterministic ordering.",
        "Exclude administrative-only RFV": "Broad cohort after removing admissions with Administrative RFV and no non-administrative RFV labels.",
        "Exclude any UNKNOWN-source gas evidence": "Broad cohort after removing admissions with any UNKNOWN/indeterminate-source gas evidence.",
        "Gas-positive excluding UNKNOWN-source gas": "Blood-gas-positive admissions after removing admissions with any UNKNOWN/indeterminate-source gas evidence.",
    }
    return definitions.get(label, "")


TABLE1_SUMMARY_MEDIAN_IQR = "median [IQR]"
TABLE1_SUMMARY_COUNT_PCT = "n (%)"
TABLE1_ALLOWED_SUMMARY_TYPES = {TABLE1_SUMMARY_MEDIAN_IQR, TABLE1_SUMMARY_COUNT_PCT}
TABLE1_COMMA_NUMERAL_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\d,\d")
TABLE1_MEDIAN_IQR_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^-?\d+(?:\.\d+)? \[-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?--?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\]$")
TABLE1_COUNT_PCT_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^\d+ \(\d+(?:\.\d+)?%\)$")


def table1_row(
    characteristic: str,
    column: str,
    summary_type: str,
    category_value: object | None = None,
) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Define one publication Table 1 row with explicit summary semantics."""

    if summary_type not in TABLE1_ALLOWED_SUMMARY_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Table 1 summary type: {summary_type!r}")
    return {
        "Characteristic": characteristic,
        "column": column,
        "Summary type": summary_type,
        "category_value": category_value,
    }


def summarize_table1_cell(frame: pd.DataFrame, row_spec: dict[str, object]) -> str:
    """Return one Table 1 cell from explicit row metadata."""

    column = str(row_spec["column"])
    summary_type = str(row_spec["Summary type"])
    series = frame[column]
    if summary_type == TABLE1_SUMMARY_MEDIAN_IQR:
        return format_median_iqr(series)
    if summary_type == TABLE1_SUMMARY_COUNT_PCT:
        category_value = row_spec.get("category_value")
        if category_value is None:
            count = int(to_binary_flag(series).eq(1).sum())
        else:
            count = int(series.eq(category_value).sum())
        return format_count_pct_no_commas(count, len(frame))
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Table 1 summary type: {summary_type!r}")


def validate_table1_output(table: pd.DataFrame, *, table_name: str) -> None:
    """Fail before export if Table 1 display contracts are violated."""

    required_columns = {"Characteristic", "Summary type"}
    missing_columns = sorted(required_columns.difference(table.columns))
    if missing_columns:
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} missing required columns: {missing_columns}")
    unsupported_types = sorted(set(table["Summary type"]).difference(TABLE1_ALLOWED_SUMMARY_TYPES))
    if unsupported_types:
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} has unsupported summary types: {unsupported_types}")
    string_table = table.astype(str)
    comma_hits = string_table.apply(lambda column: column.str.contains(TABLE1_COMMA_NUMERAL_PATTERN, regex=True, na=False))
    if comma_hits.to_numpy().any():
        hit_rows, hit_cols = np.where(comma_hits.to_numpy())
        examples = [
            f"{table.columns[col]}={string_table.iat[row, col]}"
            for row, col in zip(hit_rows[:5], hit_cols[:5], strict=False)
        ]
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} contains comma-formatted numerals: {examples}")

    value_columns = [column for column in table.columns if column not in {"Characteristic", "Summary type"}]
    count_rows = table["Summary type"].eq(TABLE1_SUMMARY_COUNT_PCT)
    median_rows = table["Summary type"].eq(TABLE1_SUMMARY_MEDIAN_IQR)
    count_values = table.loc[count_rows, value_columns].astype(str)
    median_values = table.loc[median_rows, value_columns].astype(str)
    count_as_median = count_values.apply(lambda column: column.str.contains(TABLE1_MEDIAN_IQR_PATTERN, regex=True, na=False))
    median_as_count = median_values.apply(lambda column: column.str.contains(TABLE1_COUNT_PCT_PATTERN, regex=True, na=False))
    if count_as_median.to_numpy().any():
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} has n (%) rows displayed as median [IQR].")
    if median_as_count.to_numpy().any():
        raise ValueError(f"{table_name} has median [IQR] rows displayed as n (%).")


def build_table1_frame(
    row_specs: list[dict[str, object]],
    group_frames: dict[str, pd.DataFrame],
    *,
    table_name: str,
) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Build one publication Table 1 workbook sheet from explicit row specs."""

    required_columns = sorted({str(row["column"]) for row in row_specs})
    for group_name, frame in group_frames.items():
        try:
            ensure_required_columns(frame, required_columns)
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise KeyError(f"{table_name} source columns missing for group '{group_name}'.") from exc
    rows = []
    for row_spec in row_specs:
        output_row = {
            "Characteristic": str(row_spec["Characteristic"]),
            "Summary type": str(row_spec["Summary type"]),
        }
        for group_name, frame in group_frames.items():
            output_row[f"{group_name} (N={len(frame)})"] = summarize_table1_cell(frame, row_spec)
        rows.append(output_row)
    table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    validate_table1_output(table, table_name=table_name)
    return table


def format_table1_excel(path: Path) -> None:
    """Apply copy-paste-friendly Excel formatting to publication Table 1 workbooks."""

    workbook = load_workbook(path)
    header_fill = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="E6EDF3")
    for worksheet in workbook.worksheets:
        if worksheet.merged_cells.ranges:
            raise ValueError(f"{path.name} has merged cells on sheet '{worksheet.title}'.")
        worksheet.freeze_panes = "A2"
        worksheet.sheet_view.showGridLines = False
        for cell in worksheet[1]:
            cell.font = Font(bold=True)
            cell.fill = header_fill
            cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
        for row in worksheet.iter_rows(min_row=2):
            for cell in row:
                cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="left", vertical="top", wrap_text=True)
        for column_cells in worksheet.columns:
            column_letter = column_cells[0].column_letter
            max_length = max(len(str(cell.value)) if cell.value is not None else 0 for cell in column_cells)
            if column_letter == "A":
                worksheet.column_dimensions[column_letter].width = min(max(max_length + 2, 28), 52)
            elif column_letter == "B":
                worksheet.column_dimensions[column_letter].width = 16
            else:
                worksheet.column_dimensions[column_letter].width = min(max(max_length + 2, 18), 26)
    workbook.save(path)


def model_or_table(model: object) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Convert a fitted logistic model to a tidy OR table."""

    params = model.params
    conf = model.conf_int()
    out = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "OR": np.exp(params),
            "LCI": np.exp(conf[0]),
            "UCI": np.exp(conf[1]),
            "p_value": model.pvalues,
        }
    )
    return out


def publication_table(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """Format a tidy OR table for manuscript-export publication use."""

    out = df.copy()
    out["OR (95% CI)"] = out.apply(
        lambda row: f"{row['OR']:.2f} ({row['LCI']:.2f}-{row['UCI']:.2f})",
        axis=1,
    )
    out["p_value"] = out["p_value"].map(lambda value: f"{value:.3f}")
    return out.reset_index(names="Predictor")


def render_dataframe_pdf(
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    output_path: Path,
    *,
    title: str,
    font_size: int = 8,
    scale_x: float = 1.1,
    scale_y: float = 1.18,
) -> Path:
    """Render a dataframe to a simple PDF table using matplotlib for manuscript assets."""

    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    display_df = frame.copy()
    display_df.columns = [str(column) for column in display_df.columns]
    n_rows = max(len(display_df), 1)
    fig_height = min(max(2.8, 0.32 * n_rows + 1.6), 18)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13.5, fig_height))
    ax.axis("off")
    if title:
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=ANALYSIS_FIGURE_STYLE["title_size"], fontweight="bold", pad=12)
    table = ax.table(
        cellText=display_df.fillna("").astype(str).values,
        colLabels=display_df.columns.tolist(),
        loc="center",
        cellLoc="left",
    )
    table.auto_set_font_size(False)
    table.set_fontsize(font_size)
    table.scale(scale_x, scale_y)
    for (row_idx, _), cell in table.get_celld().items():
        cell.set_edgecolor("#d9dde3")
        if row_idx == 0:
            cell.set_facecolor("#e6edf3")
            cell.set_text_props(weight="bold")
    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(output_path, bbox_inches="tight", facecolor="white")
    plt.close(fig)
    return output_path


def write_pdf_table_export(
    key: str,
    frame: pd.DataFrame,
    *,
    title: str,
    builder: str,
    font_size: int = 8,
    scale_x: float = 1.1,
    scale_y: float = 1.18,
) -> Path:
    """Render one PDF table artifact and register it in the unified export registry."""

    output_path, scope, manuscript_asset_name = resolve_export_target(key)
    render_dataframe_pdf(
        frame,
        output_path,
        title=title,
        font_size=font_size,
        scale_x=scale_x,
        scale_y=scale_y,
    )
    register_export(
        key=key,
        output_path=output_path,
        builder=builder,
        artifact_kind="table",
        scope=scope,
        formats=["pdf"],
        manuscript_asset_name=manuscript_asset_name,
    )
    return output_path

assert rfv_comorbidity_denominators.equals(rfv_comorbidity_full_denominators)
rfv_comorbidity_absolute_differences = pd.concat(

    }
)
```

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-003b
vital_preference_specs = {
    "triage_temp_f": ("ed_triage_temp_f_clean", "ed_triage_temp"),
    "first_temp_f": ("ed_first_temp_f_clean", "ed_first_temp"),
    "triage_pain": ("ed_triage_pain_clean", "ed_triage_pain"),
    "first_pain": ("ed_first_pain_clean", "ed_first_pain"),
    "triage_sbp": ("ed_triage_sbp_clean", "ed_triage_sbp"),
    "first_sbp": ("ed_first_sbp_clean", "ed_first_sbp"),
    "triage_dbp": ("ed_triage_dbp_clean", "ed_triage_dbp"),
    "first_dbp": ("ed_first_dbp_clean", "ed_first_dbp"),
    "triage_o2sat": ("ed_triage_o2sat_clean", "ed_triage_o2sat"),
    "first_o2sat": ("ed_first_o2sat_clean", "ed_first_o2sat"),
}

selected_vital_columns: dict[str, str | None] = {}
vitals_quality_rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
for vital_name, (clean_col, fallback_col) in vital_preference_specs.items():
    selected_column = select_preferred_vital_column(
        df,
        clean_column=clean_col,
        fallback_model_column=fallback_col,
    )
    selected_vital_columns[vital_name] = selected_column
    if selected_column is None:
        vitals_quality_rows.append(
            {
                "vital_name": vital_name,
                "selected_column": None,
                "n_non_missing": 0,
                "median": np.nan,
                "mean": np.nan,
            }
        )
        continue
    numeric = pd.to_numeric(df[selected_column], errors="coerce")
    vitals_quality_rows.append(
        {
            "vital_name": vital_name,
            "selected_column": selected_column,
            "n_non_missing": int(numeric.notna().sum()),
            "median": float(numeric.median()) if numeric.notna().any() else np.nan,
            "mean": float(numeric.mean()) if numeric.notna().any() else np.nan,
        }
    )
```

## Symptom Composition By Hypercapnia Definition

Generate admission-level multi-label prevalence summaries. Each admission contributes once to every RFV category present across `RFV1_name..RFV5_name`, so percentages are not mutually exclusive and may exceed 100 when summed across categories.

```{python}
#| label: hypercap-cc-nlp-analysis-cell-006
definition_frames: list[pd.DataFrame] = []
for definition in HYPERCAP_CRITERIA:
    definition_subset = analytic_df.loc[analytic_df[definition].eq(1)].copy()
    if definition_subset.empty:
        continue
    definition_subset["Hypercapnia_Definition"] = definition
    definition_summary = summarize_multilabel_prevalence(
        definition_subset,
        strata="Hypercapnia_Definition",
    )
    definition_frames.append(definition_summary)

definition_counts_df = pd.concat(definition_frames, ignore_index=True)
definition_counts_df = add_wilson_ci(definition_counts_df)
definition_counts_df["Definition_Label"] = definition_counts_df["Hypercapnia_Definition"].map(
    prevalence_label_map
).fillna(definition_counts_df["Hypercapnia_Definition"])
definition_counts_df["pct_of_encounters"] = definition_counts_df["pct_of_encounters"].round(2)
definition_counts_df["CI_lower"] = definition_counts_df["CI_lower"].round(2)
definition_counts_df["CI_upper"] = definition_counts_df["CI_upper"].round(2)
definition_counts_df = definition_counts_df.sort_values(
    ["Hypercapnia_Definition", "n_with_category", "category"],
    ascending=[True, False, True],
)

definition_pivot_df = (
    definition_counts_df.pivot_table(
        index="category",
        columns="Definition_Label",
        values="pct_of_encounters",
        fill_value=0,
        observed=False,
    )
    .round(2)
)

definition_output_path = write_excel_export(
    key="symptom_composition_by_hypercap_definition",
    filename="Symptom_Composition_by_Hypercapnia_Definition.xlsx",
    builder="summarize_multilabel_prevalence_by_definition",
    sheets=[
        {"sheet_name": "Prevalence_Tidy", "df": definition_counts_df, "index": False},
        {"sheet_name": "ChartReady_Pivot", "df": definition_pivot_df.reset_index(), "index": False},
    ],
)
pivot_output_path = write_excel_export(
    key="symptom_composition_pivot_chartready",
    filename="Symptom_Composition_Pivot_ChartReady.xlsx",
    builder="summarize_multilabel_prevalence_by_definition",
    sheets=[
        {"sheet_name": "Sheet1", "df": definition_pivot_df, "index": True},
    ],
)

note_export(definition_output_path)
note_export(pivot_output_path)
```
